profile.plan: Searches Umbral Horror monsters and Rank-Up Summons Chaos Xyz Monsters (CXyz, Number C), stacking their boards with materials using the Field Spells, which also protect the Xyz Monsters and let Barian's Seal negate while adding materials from the field or GY.

weaknesses.label: Xyz Summons from the Extra Deck
weaknesses.why: Every finisher is an Xyz Summon from the Extra Deck via Rank-Up-Magic or Barian's Chaos Draw, so a card that negates that Summon ends the turn before the Chaos monster arrives.

weaknesses.label: Searches Umbral Horrors
weaknesses.why: Barian's Seventh Untopia and Barian's Chaos Draw's copy effect add or send cards from the Deck, so a hand trap that stops adding from the Deck cuts off the engine.

weaknesses.label: Protection from the Field Spells
weaknesses.why: Barian Untopia gives the Chaos Xyz board destruction protection and targeting protection, so removing the face-up Field Spell leaves the monsters vulnerable.

weaknesses.label: Lives in the GY
weaknesses.why: Barian's Seal and Barian's Hope activate by banishing themselves from the GY, so a card that banishes them from the GY or banishes cards sent there turns off their recursion.

weaknesses.label: Ends on a protected Xyz board
weaknesses.why: Going second you face Chaos Xyz Monsters that cannot be targeted or destroyed with Barian's Seal backing them, so non-targeting mass removal is the way through.

answers.name: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring
answers.why: Negates Barian's Seventh Untopia's search and the Summons from the Deck in Barian's Chaos Draw and Barian's Hope.

answers.why: Stops every add from the Deck after the first search, starving the Rank-Up engine.

answers.name: D.D. Crow
answers.why: Banishes Barian's Seal or Barian's Hope from the GY before their banish-cost effects can be used, and hits Umbral Horror recursion.

answers.name: Ghost Belle & Haunted Mansion
answers.why: Negates the GY activations and Special Summons from the GY and Extra Deck that the Rank-Up combo relies on.

answers.name: Dark Ruler No More
answers.why: Negates all the Chaos Xyz Monsters' effects, including the ones protected by the Field Spell.

answers.name: Evenly Matched
answers.why: Banishes the protected Xyz board face-down without targeting or destroying.

weaknesses.label: Traps activated from the GY

weaknesses.label: Runs on Trap Cards

weaknesses.label: Ends on Rexterm plus Counter Traps

profile.plan: A toolbox of Fusion Spells that Fusion Summon from every zone: hand, field, Deck, GY, banishment and even the opponent's monsters, with Normal Spells searching materials and Continuous Spells cheating big Fusions using monsters from the Deck and GY.

weaknesses.why: Every card in the deck is a Fusion Summon enabler, so a floodgate that forbids Fusion Summoning or Special Summons from the Extra Deck turns off every play.

weaknesses.why: Heavy Polymerization, Face Card Fusion and Primite Fusion are activated Spell Cards that Fusion Summon, so a Counter Trap that negates a Spell's activation stops the Fusion outright.

weaknesses.why: Fusion Armament, Overload Future Fusion and Primite Fusion Special Summon or banish materials from the GY, so banishing the GY or the targeted material removes the fuel for those Fusions.

weaknesses.label: Searches materials
weaknesses.why: Primite Fusion's banish effect and Fusion Draft both add Fusion materials from the Deck to the hand, so a hand trap that stops adding from the Deck cuts off its fuel.

weaknesses.label: Continuous Spells hold the board

weaknesses.label: Monster effects on the field

weaknesses.label: Spell Card activation

weaknesses.label: Trap activations
weaknesses.why: Every card in the deck is a Normal Trap and the GY Summons only trigger when a Trap Card is activated, so a floodgate that forbids Trap activations stops the whole engine.

weaknesses.label: GY Trap Summons
weaknesses.why: The deck's Trap Cards Special Summon themselves from the GY, so a hand trap that banishes them there or negates that GY effect stops the Rank 2 material.

weaknesses.label: Xyz monster effects
weaknesses.why: The Rank 2 Xyz Monsters are unaffected by monster effects but not by Trap effects, so a Trap that negates monster effects turns off their searching and destruction.

weaknesses.label: Deck searches and sends
weaknesses.why: The deck adds and sends Trap Cards from the Deck, so a hand trap that negates Deck effects stops the search before the first body is made.

weaknesses.label: Cards must reach GY
weaknesses.why: Cards only Summon themselves from the GY, so an effect that banishes cards instead of sending them there leaves nothing to activate.

weaknesses.label: Set Trap backrow
weaknesses.why: The deck's monsters and disruption come from Set Traps, so mass Spell/Trap removal clears the backrow before it can summon.

answers.name: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring
answers.why: Negates the effect that adds a Trap from the Deck or sends one from the Deck to the GY.

answers.name: Dimension Shifter
answers.why: Makes every card sent to the GY banished instead, so the Trap Cards never reach the GY to Special Summon themselves.

answers.name: D.D. Crow
answers.why: Banishes one of the deck's Trap Cards from the GY before its GY effect can Special Summon it.

answers.name: Ghost Belle & Haunted Mansion
answers.why: Negates the GY effect that Special Summons a Trap Card as a monster.

answers.name: Infinite Impermanence
answers.why: Negates a Rank 2 Xyz Monster's effect, which is protected from monster effects but not from Trap effects.

answers.name: Skill Drain
answers.why: Negates the effects of the face-up Xyz Monsters, which are not protected from Trap effects.

answers.name: Denko Sekka
answers.why: Stops Setting and activating Spell/Trap Cards, so the Trap-based engine cannot start or trigger its GY Summons.

answers.name: Harpie's Feather Duster
answers.why: Destroys the Set Trap Cards before they can be activated, removing the deck's bodies and disruption.

profile.plan: Sets up two Pendulum Scales, Pendulum Summons a board of Fiend Abyss Actors, and backs it with Abyss Script Spells Set from the Deck (Superstar, Leading Lady) plus Fantastic Theater, whose effect turns the opponent's monster effects into 'destroy 1 Set Spell/Trap'.

weaknesses.label: Searches from the Deck
weaknesses.why: Dress Rehearsal adds an Abyss Actor plus an Abyss Script, Fantastic Theater and Mellow Madonna add more, so a hand trap that negates adds from the Deck cuts the combo at its first play.

weaknesses.label: All monsters are Fiend and DARK
weaknesses.why: Every Abyss Actor is a Fiend DARK Pendulum Monster, so a floodgate that only lets a player control one Type or Attribute shuts off the whole Pendulum Summon and every subsequent play.

weaknesses.label: Pendulum Summons a wide board
weaknesses.why: The deck scales up and Pendulum Summons several Abyss Actors at once (Hyper Director, Extra Deck re-summons), so cards that punish five or more Summons wipe the board mid-combo.

weaknesses.label: Monster effects on the field
weaknesses.why: Mellow Madonna's Deck Special Summon, Hyper Director's Pendulum Zone swap and Super Producer's placing effect are all monster effects on the field, so negating a face-up monster ends the turn; this only works before Fantastic Theater is up, which rewrites them.

weaknesses.label: Runs on its Continuous Spells
weaknesses.why: Fantastic Theater searches and rewrites the opponent's monster effects while Abysstainment and Wild Wagon keep the engine and protection going, so removing those Spells (banishing, not destroying, to avoid the Set Abyss Script triggers) breaks the board.

weaknesses.label: Protected but small end board
weaknesses.why: The end board is Pendulum Summoned Abyss Actors with Wild Wagon's targeting protection and Sassy Rookie's destruction protection, so non-targeting board breakers and mass removal get through going second.

answers.name: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring
answers.why: Negates Dress Rehearsal's double search, Fantastic Theater's add or Mellow Madonna's Pendulum effect before the scales are set.

answers.name: Droll & Lock Bird
answers.why: Dress Rehearsal adds two cards at once and Back Stage follows up, so after the first add Droll stops every further search.

answers.name: Infinite Impermanence
answers.why: Negates Mellow Madonna's Deck Special Summon, Hyper Director's Pendulum Zone swap or Super Producer's placing effect.

answers.name: Nibiru, the Primal Being
answers.why: Tributes the whole Pendulum Summoned board once the combo has Summoned five or more monsters.

answers.name: Rivalry of Warlords
answers.why: Every Abyss Actor is a Fiend, so the deck can only keep one on the field and cannot Pendulum Summon a board.

answers.name: Gozen Match
answers.why: Every Abyss Actor is DARK, so the floodgate strips the board and blocks the Pendulum Summon.

answers.name: Cosmic Cyclone
answers.why: Banishes Fantastic Theater or Abysstainment without destroying a Set Abyss Script, so their 'destroyed by an opponent's card effect' bonuses never trigger.

answers.name: Evenly Matched
answers.why: Banishes the Pendulum Summoned board face-down at the end of the Battle Phase, past Wild Wagon's targeting protection.

weaknesses.label: Monster effects on the field

weaknesses.label: Face-down end board

weaknesses.label: GY recursion

answers.name: Effect Veiler

answers.name: Called by the Grave

profile.plan: It Normal Summons Gemini monsters a second time to turn on their effects, searches its Field Spell and Trap with its Spell and Level 2 Gemini, and ends on Vola-Chemicritter Methydraco with Xyz Material protecting the Gemini board.

weaknesses.label: GY setup and revivals

weaknesses.label: Monster effects on the field
weaknesses.why: Its Level 2 Gemini monsters, its Level 8 Fiend and its Xyz boss all use face-up monster effects, so negating a Gemini's gained effect or the Xyz's protection stops the combo and the payoff.

weaknesses.label: Summons five or more times

weaknesses.label: Ends on a protected Xyz board

weaknesses.label: Relies on Field Spell and Trap
weaknesses.why: Its search Spell fetches the Field Spell that gives extra Normal Summons and the Trap that Special Summons two Gemini from the Deck, so backrow removal strips both.

weaknesses.label: Effects that activate in the GY

weaknesses.label: Defence is only attack negation
weaknesses.why: Going second the board's only protection is Sigma Minus negating attacks and Sigma Plus redirecting them, so removal that never battles clears the big Rock monsters.

profile.plan: Uses Machine WATER Tuners and effects that destroy their own cards to Special Summon Tuners from the Deck, then Quick Synchro Summons Machine Synchro Monsters during the opponent's turn, ending on Quariongandrax or Phoenix with Crystron Cluster and Crystolic Potential.

weaknesses.why: Smiger, Thystvern, Rosenix and Prasiortle destroy a card to Special Summon a Crystron Tuner from the Deck, and Sulfador sends Crystron cards from the Deck to the GY; a hand trap that negates Deck effects stops the first play.

weaknesses.label: Monster effects on the field
weaknesses.why: The destroy-and-Summon effects of Smiger, Thystvern, Rosenix and Prasiortle and the Quick Effects of Quan, Citree and Rion are face-up monster effects, so negating one ends the line.

weaknesses.label: Summons many monsters
weaknesses.why: A full Crystron line Special Summons Halqifibrax, multiple Tuners and Synchro Monsters, so Nibiru can Tribute the board once five or more are Summoned.

weaknesses.label: All monsters are Machine
weaknesses.why: Every Crystron monster is Machine-Type, so There Can Be Only One leaves them with only one monster on the field.

weaknesses.label: Banishes from the Graveyard
weaknesses.why: Smiger, Thystvern, Rosenix and Prasiortle banish themselves from the GY for their search and Summon effects, so a card that forbids banishing turns those effects off.

weaknesses.label: Ends on backrow protection
weaknesses.why: Crystron Cluster protects the board from being banished and Crystolic Potential draws in the End Phase, so backrow removal such as Harpie's Feather Duster clears both before the monsters are answered.

profile.plan: Ritual Summons LIGHT Fairy Cyber Angel monsters with the Machine Angel Ritual Spells, Tributing Cyber Petit Angel, Cyber Egg Angel and Benten to search, and ends on Dakini, Izana or Vrash backed by Machine Angel Ritual in the GY.

weaknesses.label: Searches from the Deck
weaknesses.why: Cyber Petit Angel and Cyber Egg Angel add a Cyber Angel monster or Machine Angel Spell from the Deck on Summon, Benten adds a LIGHT Fairy when Tributed and Idaten adds a Ritual Spell, so a hand trap that negates an add from the Deck cuts the first search and starves the Ritual Summon.

weaknesses.label: Monster effects on the field
weaknesses.why: The whole engine sits on face-up monster effects - Petit Angel and Egg Angel search, Dakini and Izana trigger on Ritual Summon and Vrash negates destruction - so negating a face-up monster's effect ends the turn before a Ritual Monster lands.

weaknesses.label: Every Ritual needs Tributes
weaknesses.why: Machine Angel Ritual, Absolute Ritual and Merciful Machine Angel all Tribute Cyber Angel Ritual Monsters, so a floodgate that forbids Tributing turns off every Ritual Summon and every 'if this card is Tributed' effect of Benten and Idaten.

weaknesses.label: Ritual Summons through Ritual Spells
weaknesses.why: Benten, Dakini, Izana, Natasha and Vrash only exist after a Ritual Summon, so a card that forbids Ritual Summoning stops Machine Angel Ritual and Machine Angel Absolute Ritual from ever resolving.

weaknesses.label: End board protected from destruction
weaknesses.why: Machine Angel Ritual in the GY banishes itself so the LIGHT Ritual Monsters cannot be destroyed, Incarnated Machine Angel stops them dying in battle and Vrash negates destruction effects, so board breakers that banish or do not destroy are what get through Dakini, Izana and Vrash.

answers.name: Effect Veiler

profile.plan: The deck draws and reveals Flower Cardian cards to Special Summon them from the hand, stacks and Summons bodies from the Deck with Flower Gathering and Super Koi Koi, then Synchro Summons Lightshower and Lightflare as a protected, Spell/Trap-negating board.

weaknesses.label: Deck Summoning and searching
weaknesses.why: Flower Gathering and Super Koi Koi Special Summon bodies from the Deck and Cherry Blossom takes a monster from the Deck, so Ash Blossom negates the first such effect.

weaknesses.label: Monster effects on the field
weaknesses.why: Cherry Blossom, Peony and the 'with' monsters draw and Summon through face-up monster effects, so Infinite Impermanence negates the first one and cuts the combo.

weaknesses.label: Summons five or more monsters
weaknesses.why: Flower Gathering alone puts four bodies on the field and Super Koi Koi adds more, so Nibiru can Tribute the board before the Synchro Summon.

weaknesses.label: All monsters are Warrior
weaknesses.why: Every Flower Cardian monster is a Warrior, so There Can Be Only One leaves the deck unable to keep the multiple Warrior bodies needed for a Synchro Summon.

weaknesses.label: All monsters are DARK
weaknesses.why: Every Flower Cardian monster is DARK, so Gozen Match reduces each player to one Attribute and stops the deck from assembling materials.

weaknesses.label: Lightshower protection
weaknesses.why: Lightshower stops Flower Cardian monsters from being targeted or destroyed, so non-targeting answers like Super Polymerization, Evenly Matched or Lava Golem are needed to break the board.

answers.name: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring
answers.why: Negates Flower Gathering, Super Koi Koi or Cherry Blossom's Deck-to-hand/Special Summon effect.

answers.name: Infinite Impermanence
answers.why: Negates Cherry Blossom or another face-up Flower Cardian before its draw or Special Summon effect resolves.

answers.name: Nibiru, the Primal Being
answers.why: Tributes the board once Flower Gathering, Super Koi Koi and the Synchro Summons reach five Summons.

answers.name: There Can Be Only One
answers.why: All Flower Cardian monsters are Warrior, so it stops them from keeping multiple bodies on the field.

answers.name: Gozen Match
answers.why: All Flower Cardian monsters are DARK, so it stops them from keeping multiple Attributes on the field.

answers.name: Evenly Matched
answers.why: Banishes the established Flower Cardian Synchro board face-down without targeting, bypassing Lightshower's protection.

answers.name: Super Polymerization
answers.why: Fuses two DARK Flower Cardian Synchro Monsters into Starving Venom Fusion Dragon without targeting, bypassing Lightshower and Lightflare.

answers.name: Lava Golem
answers.why: Tribues two Flower Cardian Synchro Monsters without targeting or destroying them, removing Lightshower and Lightflare.

profile.plan: A Pendulum-Fusion deck that uses the Metalfoes Pendulum effects to destroy its own cards and Set Metalfoes Spells/Traps, Link Summons Electrumite for Extra Deck setup and draws, then Fusion Summons Mithrilium, Orichalc, Alkahest or Azortless while supporting them with Counter, Combination and Metamorformation.

weaknesses.label: Pendulum effects activate
weaknesses.why: The Metalfoes Pendulum effects activate as Spell effects to destroy a card and Set a Trap, so Ghost Ogre & Snow Rabbit can destroy the Pendulum monster before the Set resolves.

weaknesses.label: Pendulum Zone Spell Cards
weaknesses.why: The deck places Pendulum monsters in the Pendulum Zones and activates Metalfoes Fusion, Parametalfoes Fusion and Fullmetalfoes Fusion as Spell Cards, so Anti-Spell Fragrance stops both the scales and the Fusion Spells.

weaknesses.label: All Psychic and FIRE
weaknesses.why: Every Metalfoes monster is Psychic/FIRE, so Gozen Match or Rivalry of Warlords limits them to one monster and stops the multiple-body Fusion and Link plays.

weaknesses.label: Fusion Summoning
weaknesses.why: Metalfoes Fusion, Parametalfoes Fusion and Fullmetalfoes Fusion bring out the Fusion Monsters, so Dimensional Barrier declaring Fusion stops those Summons and negates the Fusion Monsters.

weaknesses.label: Face-up monster effects
weaknesses.why: Electrumite, Mithrilium, Orichalc, Alkahest and Amalgam all use effects on the field, so Infinite Impermanence or Skill Drain negates them and removes the payoff.

weaknesses.label: Set Traps and Field Spell
weaknesses.why: The deck Sets Metalfoes Counter and Combination and relies on Metamorformation, so Harpie's Feather Duster clears the backrow and Field Spell that support the Fusion Monsters.

answers.name: Ghost Ogre & Snow Rabbit
answers.why: Destroys a Pendulum monster when its Pendulum effect activates, or Electrumite on its Link Summon.

answers.name: Anti-Spell Fragrance
answers.why: Stops the Pendulum monsters from being placed and the Fusion Spells from being activated.

answers.name: Gozen Match
answers.why: All Metalfoes are FIRE, so it restricts them to one FIRE monster.

answers.name: Rivalry of Warlords
answers.why: All Metalfoes are Psychic, so it restricts them to one Psychic monster.

answers.name: Dimensional Barrier
answers.why: Declaring Fusion stops the Fusion Summons and negates the Fusion Monsters.

answers.name: Infinite Impermanence
answers.why: Negates Electrumite or a Metalfoes Fusion Monster's effect on the field.

answers.name: Skill Drain
answers.why: Negates the face-up effects of Electrumite, Mithrilium, Orichalc, Alkahest and Amalgam.

answers.name: Harpie's Feather Duster
answers.why: Destroys Metalfoes Counter, Combination and Metamorformation.

profile.plan: Normal Summons Rock monsters with a Triamid Field Spell up, uses Hunter, Master and Dancer to swap Field Spells during the opponent's turn for their sent-to-GY searches, and ends on Triamid Sphinx protected by Triamid Fortress with Loading and Pulse as backrow.

weaknesses.label: Field Spell in the Field Zone
weaknesses.why: Hunter, Master and Dancer send the face-up Field Spell to the GY to activate another, and Cruiser, Fortress and Kingolem only get their add or Special Summon if that card is sent to the GY; banishing it instead stops the swap and the trigger.

weaknesses.label: Searches and Summons from Deck
weaknesses.why: Cruiser adds a monster from the Deck when sent to the GY and Loading adds a Spell/Trap and can Special Summon a monster from the Deck, so Ash Blossom and Droll cut the engine.

weaknesses.label: Monster effects on the field
weaknesses.why: Hunter, Master and Dancer use Quick Effects to swap Field Spells and Sphinx's attack lock is a monster effect, so negating a face-up monster stops the disruption.

weaknesses.label: Destruction-protected board
weaknesses.why: Fortress makes Triamid monsters unable to be destroyed by card effects, so destruction-based board breakers fail and the board must be banished or Tributed.

weaknesses.label: Sphinx as an attack wall
weaknesses.why: Sphinx forces opponent's monsters to attack it and gains ATK and DEF from Field Spells in the GY, so Tributing it away is the clean out.

weaknesses.label: Continuous backrow end board
weaknesses.why: Loading and Pulse are Continuous Spell and Trap cards that keep the engine and removal going, so backrow removal clears them before the Sphinx board can grind.

answers.name: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring
answers.why: Negates Cruiser's add from the Deck or Loading's add or Special Summon from the Deck.

answers.name: Droll & Lock Bird
answers.why: After the first search, it stops Cruiser and Loading from adding more cards from the Deck.

answers.name: Infinite Impermanence
answers.why: Negates Hunter, Master or Dancer's Quick Effect before it swaps the Field Spell, or negates Sphinx.

answers.name: Effect Veiler
answers.why: Negates the first Rock monster's Field Spell swap or Sphinx's effect.

answers.name: Cosmic Cyclone
answers.why: Banishes the face-up Field Spell so Cruiser, Fortress or Kingolem never get their sent-to-GY trigger.

answers.name: Evenly Matched
answers.why: Banishes the Sphinx board and backrow face-down, bypassing Fortress's destruction protection.

answers.name: Gameciel, the Sea Turtle Kaiju
answers.why: Tributing Sphinx removes the attack wall without destroying it, and Fortress does not stop Tributes.

answers.name: Harpie's Feather Duster
answers.why: Clears the Field Spell, Loading and Pulse, leaving the deck without its engine and backrow.

profile.plan: Fusion Summons Lunalight Fusion Monsters by sending Lunalight monsters from the Deck, hand, field or Extra Deck to the GY, ending on protected battle bosses like Leo Dancer and Sabre Dancer with Masquerade and Serenade Dance support.

weaknesses.label: Deck searches and sends
weaknesses.why: Gold Leo, Black Sheep and Yellow Marten add cards from the Deck while Kaleido Chick and Masquerade send Lunalight cards from it, so Ash Blossom negates that search or send and Droll & Lock Bird stops the repeated adds.

weaknesses.label: Monster effects on the field
weaknesses.why: Gold Leo, White Rabbit and Scarlet Tiger start the combo with face-up monster effects, so negating one of those effects stops the turn before a Fusion Summon.

weaknesses.label: Effects in the GY
weaknesses.why: Silver Hound and Crimson Fox negate from the GY, while Purple Butterfly and Perfume Dancer use their GY effects, so banishing those monsters from the GY removes the deck's protection and recovery.

weaknesses.label: Cards must be sent to the GY
weaknesses.why: Kaleido Chick, Yellow Marten and Emerald Bird only trigger when sent to the GY by card effect, so making those sends banish instead turns off every trigger.

weaknesses.label: Summons many monsters
weaknesses.why: Silver Hound, Emerald Bird, Tiger, Yellow Marten and the Fusion Summons add bodies repeatedly, so Nibiru Tributes the board once five or more monsters have been Summoned.

weaknesses.label: Protected Fusion bosses
weaknesses.why: Leo Dancer, Sabre Dancer and Liger Dancer are untargetable, indestructible or unaffected, so Tributing them for a Kaiju, Lava Golem or Sphere Mode bypasses that protection.

answers.name: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring
answers.why: Negates the effects that send Lunalight cards from the Deck to the GY or add them to the hand.

answers.name: Droll & Lock Bird
answers.why: Stops the searches and draws after the first add, starving the Fusion engine.

answers.name: Infinite Impermanence
answers.why: Negates Gold Leo, White Rabbit or Scarlet Tiger on the field before they start the combo.

answers.name: D.D. Crow
answers.why: Banishes a Lunalight monster from the GY to stop Silver Hound, Crimson Fox or a GY revival.

answers.name: Called by the Grave
answers.why: Banishes and negates a Lunalight monster in the GY before its GY effect can be used.

answers.name: Dimension Shifter
answers.why: Makes every card sent to the GY banished instead, so no sent-to-GY trigger resolves.

answers.name: Nibiru, the Primal Being
answers.why: Tributes the board after the combo has Special Summoned five or more times.

answers.name: Gameciel, the Sea Turtle Kaiju
answers.why: Tributes a protected Lunalight Fusion Monster without targeting or destroying it.

profile.plan: Sets Amorphage Pendulum Scales and Pendulum Summons Amorphage monsters, ending on two Pendulum-effect locks (no Spell activations, no Trap activations, no monster effects, no searching, no Chain Link 2+, or no Extra Deck Summons) while Tributing a monster each Standby Phase to keep the scales alive and refuelling with Amorphous Persona and Amorphage Infection.

weaknesses.label: Locks sit on the scales and backrow
weaknesses.why: Every lock is a Pendulum effect on the scales (Amorphage Lechery, Gluttony, Sloth, Greed, Wrath, Envy, Pride, Goliath) and the support sits in Amorphous Persona, Amorphage Infection and Amorphage Lysis, so a card that destroys or banishes Spells and Traps strips the locks and one of the two scales needed to Pendulum Summon.

weaknesses.label: Locks need a face-up Amorphage
weaknesses.why: Each Pendulum effect only applies while you control an Amorphage monster, so wiping Goliath, Sloth, Lechery, Gluttony and the rest with mass removal switches every lock off and leaves the scales to destroy themselves in the next Standby Phase.

weaknesses.label: Every monster is an EARTH Dragon
weaknesses.why: All Amorphage monsters are EARTH Dragons, so a floodgate that leaves each player one monster of each Type or Attribute cuts the bodies the deck needs to keep multiple Pendulum cards alive and to pay their Standby Phase Tributes.

weaknesses.label: Pays for everything with Tributes
weaknesses.why: Every Pendulum card must Tribute a monster in the Standby Phase or destroy itself, and Amorphous Persona and Amorphage Infection only pay off on those Tributes, so a card that forbids Tributing makes the whole scale lineup fall apart.

weaknesses.label: Searches and draws off Tributes
weaknesses.why: Amorphage Infection is the deck's only search and Amorphous Persona its only draw engine, both triggered by its own Tributes, so a hand trap that negates adding from the Deck starves it of the scales and monsters it needs.

answers.name: Harpie's Feather Duster
answers.why: Destroys both Pendulum Scales together with Amorphous Persona, Amorphage Infection and Amorphage Lysis, turning off every lock and the Pendulum Summon.

answers.name: Lightning Storm
answers.why: Either wipes the scales and Continuous Spells or destroys all Attack Position Amorphage monsters so the locks have nothing to stand on.

answers.name: Cosmic Cyclone
answers.why: Banishes one Pendulum Scale at Spell Speed 2, removing its lock and leaving the deck unable to Pendulum Summon with a full scale set.

answers.name: Evenly Matched
answers.why: Banishes the Amorphage monsters and backrow face-down, clearing the locks and the scales in one card.

answers.name: Mask of Restrict
answers.why: Neither player can Tribute, so every Pendulum card destroys itself in the Standby Phase instead of paying its upkeep, and Amorphous Persona and Amorphage Infection stop drawing and searching.

answers.name: Rivalry of Warlords
answers.why: All Amorphage monsters are Dragons, so the deck is left with a single monster and cannot keep several Pendulum cards fed or punish you with a wide board.

answers.name: Dimensional Barrier
answers.why: Declaring Pendulum stops the Pendulum Summons that put the Amorphage bodies on the field, leaving the scales to die to their own upkeep.

answers.name: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring
answers.why: Negates Amorphage Infection's search for an Amorphage card, the deck's only way to dig for missing scales.

profile.plan: Special Summons Level 3 LIGHT Insect monsters by changing their battle positions, Xyz Summons Rank 3 Scaradiator, then ranks up to Corebage and Rhinosebus to control the board by shuffling and destroying Defense Position monsters.

weaknesses.label: Searches and Summons from the Deck
weaknesses.why: LEDybug adds a Level 3 Insect from the Deck and Centibit Special Summons one from the Deck, so a hand trap that negates those effects stops the combo before any Xyz Summon.

weaknesses.label: Relies on battle position changes
weaknesses.why: LEDybug, Centibit and Cocoondenser only trigger when this card is changed from Attack to Defense, so negating their effects on the field stops the engine.

weaknesses.label: Only one Attribute
weaknesses.why: All Digital Bug monsters are LIGHT, so Gozen Match locks the deck to a single Attribute and prevents it from keeping multiple monsters for Xyz Summons.

weaknesses.label: Only one Type
weaknesses.why: Every Digital Bug monster is an Insect, so Rivalry of Warlords and There Can Be Only One force the deck down to one Insect and stop its Xyz Summons.

weaknesses.label: LIGHT monster effects
weaknesses.why: The deck's searches and position changes are all LIGHT monster effects, so Light-Imprisoning Mirror negates them.

weaknesses.label: Relies on Xyz Summoning
weaknesses.why: The deck must Xyz Summon Scaradiator then rank up into Corebage and Rhinosebus, so Dimensional Barrier calling Xyz stops the boss monsters.

answers.name: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring
answers.why: Negates LEDybug's search or Centibit's Special Summon from the Deck, stopping the combo before an Xyz Summon.

answers.name: Infinite Impermanence
answers.why: Negates LEDybug or Centibit on the field, preventing the battle-position change that triggers their effects.

answers.name: Gozen Match
answers.why: All Digital Bug monsters are LIGHT, so this locks the deck to one Attribute and stops it from keeping two monsters for an Xyz Summon.

answers.name: Rivalry of Warlords
answers.why: All Digital Bug monsters are Insect, so this locks the deck to one Type and stops its Xyz Summons.

answers.name: Light-Imprisoning Mirror
answers.why: Negates the effects of all LIGHT monsters on the field, shutting off every Digital Bug search and position change.

answers.name: Dimensional Barrier
answers.why: Calling Xyz prevents all Xyz Summons for the turn, so Scaradiator, Corebage and Rhinosebus never appear.

answers.name: Dark Ruler No More
answers.why: Negates the effects of all face-up monsters the opponent controls, turning off Rhinosebus and Corebage going second.

answers.name: Evenly Matched
answers.why: Banishes the entire Xyz board at the end of the Battle Phase, clearing Rhinosebus and Corebage.

profile.plan: The Layer monsters Special Summon and search each other, then the Field Spell turns them into Attribute-matched Mech Beast Xyz Monsters and combines three of them into Great Magnus.

weaknesses.label: Searches from the Deck
weaknesses.why: Blue Layer adds a card from the Deck and Black Layer adds a Spell from the Deck, so a hand trap that negates Deck adds stops the first play.

weaknesses.label: Monster effects on the field
weaknesses.why: Blue Layer, Green Layer, White Layer and Black Layer all start the combo with effects on the field, so negating a face-up monster's effect ends the turn early.

weaknesses.label: Summons many monsters
weaknesses.why: Zetan, Alphan, Green Layer and Black Layer Special Summon repeatedly, so a card that punishes five or more Summons can clear the board mid-combo.

weaknesses.label: Relies on Field Spell and Trap
weaknesses.why: Magnacarrier performs the Xyz Summons and turns into Great Magnus, while Magnaformation protects the board, so backrow removal breaks the setup.

weaknesses.label: Unaffected Great Magnus
weaknesses.why: Great Magnus with four or more materials is unaffected by card effects, so only a Tribute such as a Kaiju gets rid of it.

weaknesses.label: All bosses are Xyz Monsters
weaknesses.why: Every Mech Beast and Great Magnus is Xyz Summoned from the Extra Deck, so declaring Xyz stops the boss Summons and negates the Xyz effects already on the field.

answers.name: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring
answers.why: Negates Blue Layer's search or Zetan's send from the Deck to the GY.

answers.name: Droll & Lock Bird
answers.why: Stops every search and draw after the first, which starves the Layer engine.

answers.name: Infinite Impermanence
answers.why: Negates Blue Layer, Green Layer, White Layer or Black Layer on the field.

answers.name: Nibiru, the Primal Being
answers.why: Tributing the board after the fifth Summon punishes the Layer spam before Great Magnus is assembled.

answers.name: Dimensional Barrier
answers.why: Declaring Xyz stops all Mech Beast and Great Magnus Xyz Summons.

answers.name: Harpie's Feather Duster
answers.why: Destroys Magnacarrier and Magnaformation, removing the Field Spell and the protection.

answers.name: Cosmic Cyclone
answers.why: Banishes Magnacarrier before it can send itself to the GY to bring out Great Magnus.

answers.name: Gameciel, the Sea Turtle Kaiju
answers.why: Tributing Great Magnus gets around its otherwise complete effect protection.

profile.plan: Ritual Summons Amorphactor Pain with its Field Spell and Tribute Summons Master Peace with three Tributes, using both to skip the opponent's next Main Phase 1 and Master Peace to negate monster effects.

weaknesses.label: Ritual Summon through a Spell
weaknesses.why: Amorphactor Pain is only Ritual Summoned by a Ritual Spell that must resolve, so destroying that Spell as it activates stops the Summon and the Main Phase skip.

weaknesses.label: Three Tributes for Master Peace
weaknesses.why: Master Peace needs three Tributes to Normal Summon, so a card that forbids Tributing keeps it off the field and takes away its monster-effect negation.

weaknesses.label: Continuous Spells/Traps as fodder
weaknesses.why: Master Peace Tributes Continuous Spells/Traps and the deck runs on them, so backrow removal destroys its fodder and the Ritual Spell.

weaknesses.label: Protection only from monster effects
weaknesses.why: Master Peace's Quick Effect only negates monster effects in the hand or field, so Spell/Trap board breakers such as Evenly Matched and Dark Ruler No More resolve and clear it.

answers.name: Mask of Restrict
answers.why: Forbids all Tributes, so Master Peace cannot be Tribute Summoned and Amorphactor Pain cannot be Ritual Summoned.

answers.name: Ghost Ogre & Snow Rabbit
answers.why: Destroys the Ritual Spell or a Continuous Spell/Trap as it activates, stopping the Ritual Summon of Amorphactor Pain.

answers.name: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring
answers.why: Negates the add from the Deck of Amorphactor Pain's Graveyard effect and any search the deck uses, cutting off its follow-up.

answers.name: Infinite Impermanence
answers.why: Negates Master Peace's Quick Effect before it can negate your monster effects.

answers.name: Evenly Matched
answers.why: Banishes Master Peace face-down and the backrow; being a Trap it is not negated by Master Peace and the banish avoids its Main Phase skip.

answers.name: Dark Ruler No More
answers.why: Negates Master Peace's effects with a Spell, so its monster-effect negation cannot stop the rest of the board break.

answers.name: Gameciel, the Sea Turtle Kaiju
answers.why: Tributing it as a Summon procedure is not a monster effect, so Master Peace cannot negate it and is removed without triggering its skip.

answers.name: Harpie's Feather Duster
answers.why: Destroys the Continuous Spells/Traps Master Peace uses as Tributes and the Ritual Spell, leaving the deck without fodder.

profile.plan: Sets Pendulum Scales with Dinomist Charge and Dinomists Howling, Pendulum Summons a board of Machine WATER Dinomist monsters, and grinds with battle tricks, ATK reduction from Plesios, and Pendulum effects that destroy a scale instead to protect the board.

weaknesses.label: Searches with Dinomist Charge
weaknesses.why: Dinomist Charge adds a Dinomist monster from the Deck to the hand and Pteran adds another after a battle, so a hand trap that negates adds from the Deck leaves the deck without the scales or bodies it needs.

weaknesses.label: Pendulum Scales are Spell Cards
weaknesses.why: The deck sets up its Pendulum Zones with Dinomist Charge and Dinomists Howling plus the monsters' own Pendulum effects, so backrow removal that destroys those Spell Cards takes the Pendulum Summon away.

weaknesses.label: Every monster is Machine and WATER
weaknesses.why: Every Dinomist monster is a Machine WATER monster, so a floodgate that only lets each player control one Type or Attribute leaves the deck with a single monster on the field.

weaknesses.label: Pendulum Scales must be activated
weaknesses.why: Placing Dinomist monsters in the Pendulum Zone is activating Spell Cards, so a floodgate that forces Spell Cards to be Set first stops Charge, Howling and every scale from ever being placed.

weaknesses.label: Pendulum Summons a full board
weaknesses.why: A single Pendulum Summon puts several Dinomist monsters on the field at once and Brachion, Ceratops and Spinos add more, so a card that punishes five or more Summons wipes the board mid-combo.

weaknesses.label: Ends on a protected Pendulum board
weaknesses.why: It ends on Pendulum Summoned monsters shielded by the Pendulum effects that destroy a scale instead and backed by Howling, Rush and Eruption, so a non-targeting board breaker that ignores those protections clears it.

answers.name: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring
answers.why: Negates Dinomist Charge's search or Pteran's add from the Deck, cutting off the deck's setup.

answers.name: Droll & Lock Bird
answers.why: Stops every card added from the Deck after the first, shutting down Charge and Pteran.

answers.name: Anti-Spell Fragrance
answers.why: Forces Spell Cards to be Set first, so no Dinomist can be placed in the Pendulum Zone and no Pendulum Summon happens.

answers.name: Rivalry of Warlords
answers.why: All Dinomist monsters are Machine, so each player is limited to one monster on the field.

answers.name: Gozen Match
answers.why: All Dinomist monsters are WATER, so each player is limited to one monster on the field.

answers.name: Nibiru, the Primal Being
answers.why: Tributes the whole Pendulum Summoned board once five monsters have been Summoned.

answers.name: Harpie's Feather Duster
answers.why: Destroys the Pendulum Scales along with Dinomist Charge, Dinomic Powerload, Howling and Rush in one card.

answers.name: Evenly Matched
answers.why: Banishes the protected monsters and backrow without targeting, so the Pendulum destruction-substitutes cannot stop it.

profile.plan: Normal Summons Solitaire or Squire to Special Summon Spectralsword from the Deck, banishes Zombies for Synchro Summons, and ends on Sunsaga and Skillsaga Supremacy protecting a Zombie Synchro board.

weaknesses.label: Starters Special Summon from Deck
weaknesses.why: Solitaire Tributes a Zombie to Special Summon Spectralsword from the Deck and Squire does the same on Normal Summon, so a hand trap that negates a Summon from the Deck stops the first Synchro play.

weaknesses.label: Normal Summon effects on field
weaknesses.why: Solitaire, Squire and Spiritmaster all start their plays with a Normal Summon trigger on the field, so negating that face-up monster's effect leaves the deck with no Synchro.

weaknesses.label: Banishes its own Zombies
weaknesses.why: Spectralsword and Spectralsword Shade banish Zombies from the GY to Special Summon Synchro monsters, and Spiritmaster, Squire and Samurai only get their bonus effects when banished, so a card that forbids banishing shuts the engine down.

weaknesses.label: Uses the Graveyard
weaknesses.why: Spectralsword activates in the GY to banish itself and a Zombie for a Synchro Summon and Spiritmaster Special Summons a Shiranui from the GY, so a hand trap that negates GY effects stops the revival.

weaknesses.label: All monsters are Zombie
weaknesses.why: Every Shiranui monster and every Synchro or Link it makes is Zombie, so a floodgate that allows only one monster of each Type leaves it with a single body.

weaknesses.label: Protected Synchro end board
weaknesses.why: Skillsaga Supremacy stops Synchro Monsters being destroyed by card effects and Sunsaga banishes Shiranui to protect Zombies, so board breakers that banish, Tribute or negate get through where destruction does not.

answers.name: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring
answers.why: Negates Solitaire's or Squire's Special Summon from the Deck, stopping the first Synchro.

answers.name: Infinite Impermanence
answers.why: Negates Solitaire, Squire or Spiritmaster's on-field effect before it can Summon.

answers.name: Effect Veiler
answers.why: Negates the first Normal Summoned Shiranui's on-field effect, cutting off the Synchro climb.

answers.name: Artifact Lancea
answers.why: Forbids banishing for the turn, so Spectralsword, Shade and the 'if this card is banished' effects cannot be used.

answers.name: Ghost Belle & Haunted Mansion
answers.why: Negates Spectralsword's GY effect or Spiritmaster's GY Special Summon, stopping the revival.

answers.name: Evenly Matched
answers.why: Banishes the protected Synchro and Link board face-down, avoiding Skillsaga and Sunsaga's destruction protection.

answers.name: Dark Ruler No More
answers.why: Negates Skillsaga Supremacy and the Synchro monsters' effects for the turn so the board can be attacked over.

answers.name: There Can Be Only One
answers.why: Because every monster is Zombie, it forces them to keep only one Zombie on the field.

profile.plan: Normal Summons Buster Whelp to search and Tribute into Buster Blader, equips Dragon Buster to lock the Extra Deck, and ends on a Buster Blader Fusion that negates Dragon effects with Buster Dragon turning the opponent's monsters into Dragons.

weaknesses.label: Searches and sends from the Deck
weaknesses.why: Buster Whelp of the Destruction Swordsman adds a card from the Deck on Normal Summon, and Prologue of the Destruction Swordsman and Protector Whelp send from the Deck to the GY, so a hand trap that negates Deck effects stops the setup.

weaknesses.label: Monster effects on the field
weaknesses.why: Buster Whelp, Protector Whelp and Buster Blader start the combo with effects on the field, so negating a face-up monster's effect ends the turn early.

weaknesses.label: Extra Deck lock from an equip
weaknesses.why: Dragon Buster Destruction Sword equipped to a Buster Blader stops you Special Summoning from the Extra Deck, so backrow removal that destroys the Equip Card frees your Extra Deck.

weaknesses.label: Ends on a lock and negation board

profile.plan: Normal Summons Apoqliphort Towers or Skybase by Tributing 3 'Qli' monsters, often using Qlife's End as a 3-Tribute shortcut, ending on an unaffected boss that sends or steals the opponent's monsters.

weaknesses.label: Tribute Summoning the boss
weaknesses.why: Apoqliphort Towers and Skybase each require 3 'Qli' Tributes, so a card that forbids Tributing stops both from ever being Summoned.

weaknesses.label: Normal Summon of the boss
weaknesses.why: Towers and Skybase cannot be Special Summoned and are only Normal Summoned, so negating the Summon stops them before their protection applies.

weaknesses.label: Qli monster effects on the field
weaknesses.why: The deck needs Qli monsters as Tribute fodder, and their search and Summon effects are on the field; negating one stops the tribute count.

weaknesses.label: Trap-based tribute shortcut
weaknesses.why: Qlife's End Special Summons itself as a monster that counts as 3 Tributes, so a card that stops Trap Cards from being activated shuts off that shortcut.

weaknesses.label: Unaffected boss
weaknesses.why: Towers and Skybase are unaffected by Spell/Trap effects and low-Level monster effects, so the only out is to Tribute them away with a Kaiju or Sphere Mode.

weaknesses.label: Qli Spell/Trap support
weaknesses.why: Qlife's End protects Qli Spell/Trap Cards, and the deck sets Traps, so backrow removal clears the way and stops Qlife's End before it resolves.

answers.name: Mask of Restrict
answers.why: Neither player can Tribute, so Towers and Skybase can never be Tribute Summoned.

answers.name: Solemn Warning
answers.why: Negates the Normal Summon of Towers or Skybase before their protection applies.

answers.name: Gameciel, the Sea Turtle Kaiju
answers.why: Tributes the unaffected Towers or Skybase away as a Summoning cost.

answers.name: The Winged Dragon of Ra - Sphere Mode
answers.why: Tributues up to 3 monsters including Towers, clearing the board.

answers.name: Effect Veiler
answers.why: Negates a Qli monster's effect on the field, stopping the tribute setup.

answers.name: Infinite Impermanence
answers.why: Negates a Qli monster's effect on the field, stopping the tribute setup.

answers.name: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring
answers.why: Negates a Qli search from the Deck, cutting off tribute fodder.

answers.name: Jinzo
answers.why: Trap Cards cannot be activated, so Qlife's End never summons its 3-Tribute monster.

profile.plan: Uses 800 ATK/1000 DEF Vassal monsters that Special Summon themselves from the hand and trigger when Tributed to fuel extra Tribute Summons, ending on a Tribute Summoned boss plus hand knowledge and a hand banish.

weaknesses.label: Special Summons from hand
weaknesses.why: Mithra, Landrobe, Berlineth, Garum and Lucius all Special Summon themselves from the hand, so a lock on Special Summoning leaves the deck without tribute fodder.

weaknesses.label: Relies on Tributing
weaknesses.why: Every Vassal's payoff is an 'If this card is Tributed' trigger and Mithra grants an extra Tribute Summon, so a card that forbids Tributing turns off the entire engine.

weaknesses.label: Searches from Deck
weaknesses.why: Garum adds an 800 ATK/1000 DEF monster from the Deck to the hand when Tributed, so Ash Blossom negates the search and Droll stops later adds.

weaknesses.label: Tribute triggers in GY
weaknesses.why: Landrobe recovers an 800 ATK/1000 DEF monster from the GY and the other Vassals' Tributed effects activate there, so negating GY effects stops the payoff.

weaknesses.label: Tribute Summoned boss effects
weaknesses.why: The deck spends its Vassals on Tribute Summons, so negating the face-up Tribute Summoned monster's effect on the field stops the payoff those Tributes bought.

weaknesses.label: Ends on boss plus backrow
weaknesses.why: It ends on a Tribute Summoned monster with set cards and has banished a card from your hand, so a board breaker that clears multiple cards gets through going second.

answers.name: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring
answers.why: Negates Garum's search from the Deck.

answers.name: Droll & Lock Bird
answers.why: Stops Garum's add and any further Deck searches after the first.

answers.name: Ghost Belle & Haunted Mansion
answers.why: Negates Landrobe's GY recovery or another effect that moves a card from the GY.

answers.name: Called by the Grave
answers.why: Banishes a Tributed Vassal from the GY and negates its trigger.

answers.name: Mask of Restrict
answers.why: Forbids Tributing, so no Tribute Summon and no 'If this card is Tributed' effect ever happens.

answers.name: Vanity's Emptiness
answers.why: Forbids all Special Summons, so the Vassals cannot Special Summon themselves from the hand to be Tributed.

answers.name: Soul Drain
answers.why: Negates the effects of monsters in the GY, stopping the Tributed Vassals' triggers.

answers.name: Evenly Matched
answers.why: Banishes the Tribute Summoned board and backrow face-down at the end of the Battle Phase.

profile.plan: The deck uses Normal Spells to Special Summon Fusion Monsters from the Extra Deck and to summon Level 8 Warrior bosses from the Deck/GY, ending on an unaffected Timaeus the Knight of Destiny and battle-focused Dragons.

weaknesses.label: Normal Spell starters
weaknesses.why: The Fang of Critias, The Claw of Hermos and Legend of Heart are all Normal Spells that must resolve, so a card that negates the activation of a Spell stops the Summon before it happens.

weaknesses.label: Legend of Heart summons from Deck
weaknesses.why: Legend of Heart Special Summons the Level 8 Warriors from the hand, Deck and GY, so a hand trap that negates a Summon from the Deck leaves the deck without its bosses.

weaknesses.label: Sends to GY as cost
weaknesses.why: The Fang of Critias and The Claw of Hermos must send a Trap or monster to the GY to Summon their Fusion, so effects that banish cards instead of sending them stop those Summons.

weaknesses.label: Fusion Summons from Extra Deck
weaknesses.why: The Fang of Critias and The Claw of Hermos Special Summon Fusion Monsters from the Extra Deck, so a card that forbids Fusion Special Summons shuts off every Fusion payoff.

weaknesses.label: Unaffected boss monster
weaknesses.why: Timaeus the Knight of Destiny is unaffected by other cards' effects, so only a Tribute such as a Kaiju or Sphere Mode removes it from the field.

weaknesses.label: Spell activation floodgate
weaknesses.why: Every play is a Spell Card — The Fang of Critias, The Claw of Hermos and Legend of Heart — so a floodgate that restricts Spell activation stops them being used the turn they are drawn.

answers.name: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring
answers.why: Negates Legend of Heart's Special Summon from the Deck.

answers.name: Dimension Shifter
answers.why: Cards sent to the GY are banished instead, so The Fang of Critias and The Claw of Hermos cannot pay their costs.

answers.name: Macro Cosmos
answers.why: While it is face-up, every send to the GY is banished instead, shutting off The Fang of Critias and The Claw of Hermos.

answers.name: Dimensional Barrier
answers.why: Declare Fusion to stop The Fang of Critias and The Claw of Hermos from Special Summoning their Fusion Monsters.

answers.name: Solemn Judgment
answers.why: Negates the activation of Legend of Heart, The Fang of Critias or The Claw of Hermos.

answers.name: Anti-Spell Fragrance
answers.why: Forces Spells to be Set and delays them, so the deck cannot use its Normal Spells the turn it draws them.

answers.name: Lava Golem
answers.why: Tribues Timaeus the Knight of Destiny, which is unaffected by card effects.

answers.name: The Winged Dragon of Ra - Sphere Mode
answers.why: Tribues up to three monsters, removing Timaeus the Knight of Destiny without targeting it.

profile.plan: It sets low and high Pendulum Scales with Pendulum monsters, Pendulum Summons a wide board, then uses Fusion Summons and monster effects to search, draw and clear the opponent's field, ending on Fusion monsters and effect monsters that negate or punish.

weaknesses.label: Searches from the Deck
weaknesses.why: Its Pendulum monsters add cards from the Deck to the hand and send cards from the Deck to the GY to start the setup, so a hand trap that negates those effects stops the first play.

weaknesses.label: Pendulum Scales in the Pendulum Zones
weaknesses.why: It places Pendulum monsters as Spell Cards in the Pendulum Zones to set its scales, so backrow removal destroys the scales and turns off Pendulum Summoning.

weaknesses.label: Monster effects on the field
weaknesses.why: Its combo pieces use face-up monster effects to search, Summon and clear cards, so negating a monster's effect on the field ends the turn early.

weaknesses.label: Pendulum Summons many monsters
weaknesses.why: A full Pendulum Summon puts several monsters on the field at once, so cards that punish five or more Summons can clear the board mid-combo.

weaknesses.label: Spell-heavy setup
weaknesses.why: It relies on Normal and Quick-Play Spells and on activating Pendulum monsters as Spells, so a floodgate that stops Spell activation shuts down its setup.

answers.name: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring
answers.why: Negates the Deck searches and Deck-to-GY sends that start the Pendulum setup.

answers.name: Droll & Lock Bird
answers.why: Stops every search after the first, starving the deck of Pendulum monsters.

answers.name: Infinite Impermanence
answers.why: Negates a face-up Pendulum monster's effect before it can search or Summon.

answers.name: Effect Veiler
answers.why: Negates the first face-up monster effect that would start the combo.

answers.name: Nibiru, the Primal Being
answers.why: Tributes the wide Pendulum board once five or more monsters have been Summoned.

answers.name: Harpie's Feather Duster
answers.why: Destroys the Pendulum Scales and any Set Spells/Traps.

answers.name: Cosmic Cyclone
answers.why: Banishes a Pendulum Scale so it cannot return to the Extra Deck for a later Pendulum Summon.

answers.name: Anti-Spell Fragrance
answers.why: Stops Spell activation, including placing Pendulum Scales and the deck's Normal and Quick-Play Spells.

profile.plan: Mills its own Shaddoll cards to the GY to trigger searches, Special Summons and Fusion Summons, ending on El Shaddoll Winda with its Special Summon lock plus negation from Shekhinaga or Grysta.

weaknesses.label: Sends Shaddoll cards from Deck to GY
weaknesses.why: Shaddoll Construct, Shaddoll Squamata and Sinister Shadow Games send Shaddoll cards from the Deck to the GY to start the engine, so a hand trap that negates that send cuts the combo off.

weaknesses.label: Adds and draws from the Deck
weaknesses.why: Shaddoll Hedgehog searches Spell/Traps, El Shaddoll Apkallone adds Shaddoll cards and Shaddoll Beast draws, so Droll & Lock Bird stops every add after the first.

weaknesses.label: Effects activate in the GY
weaknesses.why: Shaddoll Beast, Squamata, Wendi and Falco all trigger in the GY when sent by a card effect, so a floodgate that negates GY monster effects shuts off the entire chain.

weaknesses.label: Monster effects on the field
weaknesses.why: El Shaddoll Apkallone negates, Shaddoll Construct sends to the GY and Shekhinaga or Grysta negate Summons, so negating a face-up monster stops the payoff.

weaknesses.label: Fusion Summons its bosses
weaknesses.why: Shaddoll Fusion, El Shaddoll Fusion and Shaddoll Schism all Fusion Summon the deck's monsters, so declaring Fusion stops the Extra Deck entirely.

weaknesses.label: Ends on protected Fusion board and backrow
weaknesses.why: El Shaddoll Winda cannot be destroyed by card effects and sits with set Schism, Sinister Shadow Games or Resh Shaddoll Incarnation, so non-destruction board wipes and backrow removal break it.

answers.name: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring
answers.why: Negates Construct's or Squamata's send from the Deck to the GY, stopping the Shaddoll trigger.

answers.name: Droll & Lock Bird
answers.why: Stops Hedgehog and Apkallone searches and Beast draws after the first add.

answers.name: Infinite Impermanence
answers.why: Negates Apkallone, Construct or a set Wendi before it can fuse or send.

answers.name: Soul Drain
answers.why: Negates the GY effects of Beast, Squamata, Wendi and Falco.

answers.name: Dimensional Barrier
answers.why: Declaring Fusion stops Shaddoll Fusion, El Shaddoll Fusion and Schism from Fusion Summoning.

answers.name: Evenly Matched
answers.why: Banishes Winda and the rest of the board face-down, bypassing its destruction protection.

answers.name: Harpie's Feather Duster
answers.why: Clears Schism, Resh Shaddoll Incarnation and Sinister Shadow Games before they can fuse or revive.

profile.plan: Pendulum Summons Level 7 Dragon monsters, Xyz Summons Rank 7 Odd-Eyes bosses that wipe the board and attack repeatedly, and backs them with Persona Dragon and All-Eyes Phantom Dragon negations plus Snake-Eyes monsters placed as Continuous Spells.

weaknesses.label: Searches from the Deck
weaknesses.why: Odd-Eyes Revolution Dragon and Odd-Eyes Pendulum Dragon add Dragon Pendulum monsters from the Deck, and Arc Pendulum Dragon Special Summons from the Deck, so a hand trap that negates those effects cuts the combo.

weaknesses.label: Monster effects on the field
weaknesses.why: Odd-Eyes Persona Dragon negates Extra Deck monsters, All-Eyes Phantom Dragon negates Spell/Traps, and Odd-Eyes Mirage Dragon protects, so negating the face-up monsters removes the interaction.

weaknesses.label: Pendulum Summoning
weaknesses.why: The deck Pendulum Summons Level 7 Dragons and then Xyz Summons them, so declaring Pendulum with Dimensional Barrier stops the Summon of every Pendulum monster.

weaknesses.label: Pendulum scales are Spell Cards
weaknesses.why: Odd-Eyes Pendulum Dragon and Arc Pendulum Dragon must be activated as Spell Cards in the Pendulum Zones, so Anti-Spell Fragrance forces them to be Set and delays the scales.

weaknesses.label: Summons many monsters
weaknesses.why: A Pendulum Summon plus Xyz Summons puts five or more monsters on the board, so Nibiru tributes it mid-combo.

weaknesses.label: Ends on Xyz Pendulum bosses
weaknesses.why: Odd-Eyes Rebellion Dragon, Raging Dragon and Overlord wipe the board and attack multiple times, so going second board breakers clear the established Rank 7 board.

answers.name: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring
answers.why: Negates the add from the Deck by Odd-Eyes Revolution Dragon or Odd-Eyes Pendulum Dragon, or Arc Pendulum Dragon's Special Summon from the Deck.

answers.name: Droll & Lock Bird
answers.why: Stops every search after the first, cutting off Revolution Dragon and the End Phase Pendulum search.

answers.name: Infinite Impermanence
answers.why: Negates Persona Dragon's Extra Deck lock or All-Eyes Phantom Dragon's Spell/Trap negation.

answers.name: Nibiru, the Primal Being
answers.why: Tributates the board after a Pendulum Summon and Xyz Summons have put five or more monsters on the field.

answers.name: Dimensional Barrier
answers.why: Declaring Pendulum stops every Pendulum Summon the deck needs for its Rank 7 Xyz plays.

answers.name: Anti-Spell Fragrance
answers.why: Forces Pendulum monsters to be Set as Spell Cards, so the scales cannot be placed and activated normally.

answers.name: Evenly Matched
answers.why: Banishes the Rank 7 Xyz board and backrow at the end of the Battle Phase.

answers.name: Super Polymerization
answers.why: Uses two of their DARK Dragons as material for Starving Venom Fusion Dragon, removing the bosses without targeting.

profile.plan: Fusion Summons LIGHT Fairy bosses from the Deck with Ostinato and 1st Movement Solo, using Refrain and Couplet to search and set Pendulum scales, and ends on protected Fusion Monsters like Bacha, Bloom Diva and Flowering Etoile.

weaknesses.label: Engine pulls from the Deck
weaknesses.why: 1st Movement Solo and Bloom Harmonist Special Summon from the Deck while Refrain and Couplet add from the Deck, so a hand trap that stops Deck effects cuts the first play before any Fusion Summon.

weaknesses.label: Monster effects on the field
weaknesses.why: Refrain searches on Summon, Bloom Harmonist summons two monsters from the Deck and Flowering Etoile bounces on a Quick Effect, so negating a face-up monster's effect breaks both the combo and the end board.

weaknesses.label: Fusion Summons
weaknesses.why: Ostinato, Melodious Concerto, Soprano and Fortissimo all Fusion Summon the deck's bosses, so an effect that forbids Fusion Summoning leaves it with only small Fairies.

weaknesses.label: All LIGHT Fairy monsters
weaknesses.why: Every Melodious monster is a LIGHT Fairy, so a floodgate that negates LIGHT monster effects turns off Refrain, Couplet, Bacha and Flowering Etoile at once.

weaknesses.label: Protected Fusion bosses
weaknesses.why: Bloom Diva cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects, Aria stops targeting and battle destruction and Bacha stops negation, so only non-targeting, non-destruction board breakers get through.

weaknesses.label: Long Special Summon combo
weaknesses.why: A full turn Special Summons five or more times through 1st Movement Solo, Bloom Harmonist and its two Summons, so Nibiru can Tribute the whole board mid-combo.

answers.name: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring
answers.why: Negates 1st Movement Solo, Bloom Harmonist or Refrain's search from the Deck.

answers.name: Droll & Lock Bird
answers.why: Stops Refrain, Couplet and Tamtam from adding multiple cards from the Deck.

answers.name: Infinite Impermanence
answers.why: Negates Refrain, Bloom Harmonist or Flowering Etoile on the field.

answers.name: Effect Veiler
answers.why: Negates the first Melodious monster effect that starts the combo.

answers.name: Nibiru, the Primal Being
answers.why: Tributes the board once the combo has Special Summoned five or more monsters.

answers.name: Non-Fusion Area
answers.why: Neither player can Fusion Summon, which stops Ostinato, Melodious Concerto and Fortissimo.

answers.name: Shadow-Imprisoning Mirror
answers.why: Negates all LIGHT monster effects, shutting off every Melodious monster effect on the field and in the GY.

answers.name: Evenly Matched
answers.why: Banishes the protected Fusion board face-down, bypassing Bloom Diva and Aria's destruction protection.

profile.plan: Special Summons its own Superheavy Samurai from the hand and Synchro Summons big Machine Synchro Monsters that attack from Defense Position using their DEF, poking over the opponent while keeping its own GY free of Spells/Traps.

weaknesses.label: Searches from the Deck
weaknesses.why: Soulpiercer adds a Superheavy Samurai from the Deck when it is sent to the GY and Wagon adds a Soul monster, so a hand trap that negates adds from the Deck cuts the combo's fuel before the first Synchro.

weaknesses.label: Monster effects on the field
weaknesses.why: Wagon, Scales and Soulpeacemaker all begin the combo with effects on the field, so negating a face-up monster's effect ends the turn before a Tuner and a body line up.

weaknesses.label: Every monster is a Machine
weaknesses.why: Soulpiercer, Wagon, Scales and every Synchro Monster in the Extra Deck is a Machine, so a card that banishes Machines clears the field and the GY in one go.

weaknesses.label: One Type only
weaknesses.why: The whole deck is Machine, so a floodgate that only lets a player control one monster of each Type leaves Superheavy Samurai with a single body on the field and no way to Synchro Summon.

weaknesses.label: Attacks from Defense Position
weaknesses.why: Soulpiercer, Big Benkei and every Synchro let the deck attack while in Defense Position and apply DEF, so flipping its monsters face-down takes away both the attack and the damage.

weaknesses.label: Ends on a Synchro board
weaknesses.why: Going second you face Steam Train King, Susanowo and Beast Kyubi sitting in Defense Position with 3800 to 4800 DEF, so non-targeting board breakers are the way through.

answers.name: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring
answers.why: Negates Soulpiercer's add from the Deck, Wagon's Soul search and Soulpeacemaker's Special Summon from the Deck.

answers.name: Infinite Impermanence
answers.why: Negates Wagon, Scales or Soulpeacemaker on the field before they produce the Tuner and the body.

answers.name: Dimensional Barrier
answers.why: Declaring Synchro stops every Synchro Summon the deck's whole game plan is built on.

answers.name: There Can Be Only One
answers.why: Every Superheavy Samurai monster is a Machine, so the deck is locked to a single monster on the field.

answers.name: System Down
answers.why: Banishes every Machine the deck controls and every Superheavy Samurai in its GY for 1000 LP.

answers.name: Nibiru, the Primal Being
answers.why: Tributes the whole Defense Position Synchro board once the combo has Special Summoned five or more times.

answers.name: Book of Moon
answers.why: Flips a Defense Position attacker face-down so it can no longer attack while applying its DEF.

answers.name: Evenly Matched
answers.why: Banishes the high-DEF Synchro board face-down without targeting, so its protections do not matter.

profile.plan: It uses Wyrm monsters that float when destroyed to Synchro Summon during either player's turn, climbing into protected Synchro monsters and backing them with Continuous Traps and a Counter Trap.

weaknesses.label: Deck Special Summons and searches
weaknesses.why: The Level 2 Tuner Special Summons from the Deck, the Synchro Tuner searches and sends from the Deck, and every destroyed Wyrm floats into another Wyrm from the Deck, so a hand trap that negates Deck effects cuts the engine at the start.

weaknesses.label: Monster effects on the field
weaknesses.why: The Level 2 Tuner and the Synchro monsters' Quick Effects all activate on the field, so negating a face-up monster's effect stops the Synchro climb and its search or draw payoff.

weaknesses.label: Relies on Synchro Summoning
weaknesses.why: The deck's payoff is Synchro Summoning with Wyrm materials during either player's turn, so a card that forbids Synchro Summons leaves it with only small monsters.

weaknesses.label: All monsters are Wyrm
weaknesses.why: Every Main Deck and Extra Deck monster is Wyrm, so a floodgate limiting each player to one Type leaves it unable to build a board.

weaknesses.label: Continuous backrow support
weaknesses.why: Its Continuous Spell/Trap support and Counter Trap protect and extend the Synchro plays, so backrow removal turns off the floating and negation.

weaknesses.label: Protected Synchro end board
weaknesses.why: It ends on untargetable, attribute-locked Synchro monsters plus backrow, so non-targeting board breakers are needed to get through going second.

answers.name: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring
answers.why: Negates the Level 2 Tuner's Deck Summon, the Synchro Tuner's search/send, and every destroyed Wyrm's Special Summon from the Deck.

answers.name: Droll & Lock Bird
answers.why: Stops every search and draw after the first, cutting off the Synchro Tuner's add and the recovery Spell's draw.

answers.name: Infinite Impermanence
answers.why: Negates the on-field Level 2 Tuner or a Synchro monster's Quick Effect before it can Synchro Summon.

answers.name: Dimensional Barrier
answers.why: Declaring Synchro stops the deck's Synchro Summons and negates its Synchro monsters' effects for the turn.

answers.name: Rivalry of Warlords
answers.why: All its monsters are Wyrm, so each player controlling only one Type leaves it with a single monster.

answers.name: Dark Ruler No More
answers.why: Negates all face-up monster effects, turning off the Synchro monsters' protection, floating and negation.

answers.name: Evenly Matched
answers.why: Banishes most of the protected Synchro board and its backrow at the end of the Battle Phase.

answers.name: Harpie's Feather Duster
answers.why: Destroys the Continuous Spells/Traps and the Counter Trap that protect and extend the Synchro plays.

profile.plan: Searches and Special Summons Deskbot monsters from the Deck to swarm 500-ATK Machine bodies, uses Deskbot Base to draw and fix the hand, then ends on a big Deskbot 009 or Synchro Deskbot Jet, with Deskbot 007 and 008 shielding the board from targeting.

weaknesses.label: Special Summons from the Deck
weaknesses.why: Deskbot 003 Special Summons a Deskbot from the Deck when Normal Summoned and Deskbot Jet does the same, so a hand trap that negates Deck effects stops the combo before it gets bodies.

weaknesses.label: Monster effects on the field
weaknesses.why: Deskbot 003's Quick Effect buff and Deskbot 002's search trigger are monster effects on the field, so negating a face-up Deskbot ends the turn's payoff.

weaknesses.label: Every monster is a Machine
weaknesses.why: Every Deskbot is Machine-Type, so System Down banishes them all from the field and GY and Chimeratech Fortress Dragon can use the whole board as Fusion material.

weaknesses.label: Recovers from the GY
weaknesses.why: Deskbot 001 Special Summons itself from the GY and Deskbot 005 and 006 recover Deskbot cards from there, so banishing the GY takes away the deck's recursion.

weaknesses.label: Key Field Spell
weaknesses.why: Deskbot Base is the draw engine and the mass shuffle effect, so destroying the Field Spell with backrow removal strips the deck of its card flow.

weaknesses.label: Targeting-protected end board
weaknesses.why: Deskbot 007 and 008 stop Deskbot cards being targeted and 009 can grow huge with battle protection, so non-targeting board breakers are needed going second.

answers.name: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring
answers.why: Negates Deskbot 002's search and Deskbot 003 or Deskbot Jet Special Summoning from the Deck.

answers.name: Droll & Lock Bird
answers.why: After the first Deskbot search it stops every further add from the Deck, cutting the deck's search chains.

answers.name: Infinite Impermanence
answers.why: Negates Deskbot 003 on the field before it Special Summons, or another Deskbot's effect.

answers.name: Ghost Ogre & Snow Rabbit
answers.why: Destroys Deskbot Base when its draw effect activates, turning off the Field Spell's card flow.

answers.name: System Down
answers.why: Banishes every Machine-Type Deskbot on the field and in the GY in one card.

answers.name: Chimeratech Fortress Dragon
answers.why: Uses all their Machine monsters as Fusion material, clearing the entire Deskbot board.

answers.name: Harpie's Feather Duster
answers.why: Destroys Deskbot Base and the Pendulum scales the deck sets up.

answers.name: Evenly Matched
answers.why: Non-targeting banishes the big Deskbot 009 or Jet board and the backrow going second.

profile.plan: Xyz Summons Rank 4 Warrior Xyz Monsters by using the 'If this card is Summoned' effects of Deneb, Altair and Vega to search, revive and Special Summon, ending on a Rank 4 Xyz with Stellarnova Alpha and backrow for negation.

weaknesses.label: Searches and sends from the Deck
weaknesses.why: Deneb adds a tellarknight from the Deck, Unukalhai sends one to the GY and Skybridge Special Summons from the Deck, so a hand trap that negates Deck effects stops the first play.

weaknesses.label: Monster effects on the field
weaknesses.why: Deneb, Altair and Vega all trigger when Summoned, so negating a face-up monster's effect ends the combo before it starts.

weaknesses.label: Rank 4 Xyz Summons
weaknesses.why: The deck's payoff is Xyz Summoning Rank 4 monsters like Batlamyus, so preventing Xyz Summons shuts off its boss monsters.

weaknesses.label: All monsters are LIGHT
weaknesses.why: Every Satellarknight is LIGHT, so Gozen Match limits each player to one Attribute and locks the deck to a single monster.

weaknesses.label: Ends on backrow and a Field Spell
weaknesses.why: The end board sets Stellarnova Alpha, Stellarnova Wave and Hexatellarknight, so backrow removal clears the negation and the ATK boost.

weaknesses.label: Ends on a protected Xyz board
weaknesses.why: Going second you face a Rank 4 Xyz with Stellarnova Alpha negating, so board breakers that clear the monster and backrow get through.

answers.name: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring
answers.why: Negates Deneb's search, Unukalhai's send from Deck, or Skybridge's Special Summon from Deck.

answers.name: Droll & Lock Bird
answers.why: Stops every search and draw after the first, cutting off Deneb, Sirius and Procyon.

answers.name: Infinite Impermanence
