answers.name: Solemn Judgment
answers.why: Negates the Summon of any Maju Garzett, Tribute Summon included, before its ATK is ever set.

answers.name: Dark Ruler No More
answers.why: Negates all of their face-up monster effects for the turn, dropping every Maju Garzett to 0 ATK so the board can be attacked over.

answers.name: Forbidden Droplet
answers.why: Negates the boss's ATK-setting effect and halves it, turning the huge Maju Garzett into a 0 ATK monster.

answers.name: Gameciel, the Sea Turtle Kaiju
answers.why: Tributes the giant Maju Garzett away as the Kaiju Summon's cost, since it has no protection from being Tributed.

profile.plan: Locks the opponent's Monster Zones with Ojama King and Ojama Knight, backs them with Ojama Country's ATK/DEF swap and revival, and can clear the board with Ojama Delta Hurricane after assembling the three vanilla Ojamas.

weaknesses.label: Uses the Graveyard

answers.why: Destroys Ojama Country and any set Ojama Trio or Ojama Duo.

weaknesses.why: Venus can Special Summon several Mystical Shine Balls and the deck Links and Synchros them, so Nibiru tributes the board once five or more monsters have been Summoned.

profile.plan: A slow Beast beatdown deck that Tributes for the Level 7 Normal Monster Big Koala and Fusions it with Des Kangaroo into Master of Oz, or Fusions Sea Koala with Tree Otter into Koalo-Koala, then wins by attacking with big ATK and burning with Des Koala's Flip effect.

weaknesses.label: Fusion Summons its bosses
weaknesses.why: Master of Oz and Koalo-Koala only exist through a Fusion Summon, so a card that forbids or negates Fusion Summoning leaves the deck with nothing but Big Koala and small Beasts.

weaknesses.label: Everything is a Beast
weaknesses.why: Big Koala, Des Koala, Sea Koala, Vampiric Koala and both Fusions are all Beast-Type, so a floodgate that limits each player to one Type or one monster of each Type locks the whole deck to a single body.

weaknesses.label: Monster effects on the field
weaknesses.why: Sea Koala's ATK-to-0, Koalo-Koala's destruction effect and Vampiric Koala's LP gain are all face-up monster effects, so negating them removes the deck's only interaction and recovery.

weaknesses.label: Big Koala needs Tributes
weaknesses.why: Big Koala is a Level 7 Normal Monster that has to be Tribute Summoned, so a card that forbids Tributing stops it ever reaching the field to be Fusioned into Master of Oz.

weaknesses.label: Unprotected big beaters
weaknesses.why: Master of Oz and Koalo-Koala have no protection or negation at all, so mass removal and board wipes simply clear the board it spent several turns building.

profile.plan: Chaos summons itself by banishing a LIGHT and a DARK from the GY, using Chaos Space and Chaos Ruler to stock the GY, and ends on protected LIGHT/DARK Synchro monsters like Chaos Angel and Chaos Ruler.

weaknesses.label: Searches and draws from the Deck
weaknesses.why: Chaos Space adds a LIGHT or DARK monster from the Deck and Chaos Ruler excavates to add, while Chaos Zone adds on destruction, so hand traps that stop adds strip the deck of fuel.

weaknesses.label: Sends from the Deck to the GY
weaknesses.why: Chaos Grepher sends a LIGHT or DARK from the Deck to the GY and Chaos Ruler sends the remaining excavated cards, so a hand trap that negates the send stops the setup.

weaknesses.label: Monster effects on the field
weaknesses.why: Chaos Sorcerer, Chaos Daedalus and Chaos Emperor Dragon use face-up monster effects to banish or send cards, so negating those effects removes the deck's interaction.

weaknesses.label: Mixes LIGHT and DARK
weaknesses.why: Chaos Angel and Chaos Archfiend need a LIGHT Tuner and DARK non-Tuner, so a floodgate that allows only one Attribute stops the Extra Deck plays.

weaknesses.label: Ends on a protected Synchro board
weaknesses.why: Going second you face Chaos Angel and Chaos Ruler with protection and banishing, so board breakers that do not target or that negate with a Spell get through.

answers.name: Droll & Lock Bird
answers.why: After the first search or draw, it stops every further add, which Chaos Space, Chaos Ruler and Chaos Zone rely on.

answers.name: Infinite Impermanence
answers.why: Negates Chaos Sorcerer, Chaos Daedalus or Chaos Emperor Dragon's banishing effect on the field.

answers.why: As a Spell it negates Chaos Angel's and Chaos Ruler's monster effects, bypassing Chaos Angel's LIGHT-material protection.

profile.plan: Uses Necrovalley and its search cards to keep Gravekeeper's monsters on board, then grinds with Shaman's GY lock, Supernaturalist's protection, Hidden Temples and Imperial Tombs while removing the opponent's monsters.

weaknesses.label: Backrow-dependent locks
weaknesses.why: Necrovalley powers Supernaturalist and Heretic, Hidden Temples locks Special Summons and Necrovalley Temple revives the Field Spell, so banishing the backrow bypasses Shaman's destruction protection and turns those locks off.

weaknesses.label: Searches from the Deck
weaknesses.why: Necrovalley Throne, Commandant, Spy, Recruiter and Supernaturalist all add or Special Summon from the Deck, so a hand trap that negates the first Deck effect stalls the engine.

weaknesses.label: Face-up monster effects
weaknesses.why: Descendant's destruction, Headman's revival, Spiritualist's Fusion and Cannonholder's burn are all face-up monster effects, so negating them stops the deck's removal and extension.

weaknesses.label: Mono-Type board
weaknesses.why: Nearly every Gravekeeper's monster is Spellcaster, so There Can Be Only One and Rivalry of Warlords reduce the board to one monster and stop Spy, Headman and Rite of Spirit from rebuilding.

weaknesses.label: DARK monster effects
weaknesses.why: Almost every Gravekeeper's monster is DARK, so Shadow-Imprisoning Mirror negates their effects on the field and in the GY, including Headman and Recruiter.

weaknesses.label: Protected end board
weaknesses.why: Supernaturalist and Heretic cannot be destroyed while Necrovalley is on the field, so going second you need non-destruction mass removal such as Evenly Matched rather than destruction-based board breakers.

answers.name: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring
answers.why: Negates Necrovalley Throne, Commandant, Spy, Recruiter or Supernaturalist when they add or Special Summon from the Deck.

answers.name: Droll & Lock Bird
answers.why: After the first search, it stops every further add from the Deck, cutting off Throne, Recruiter and Supernaturalist.

answers.name: Infinite Impermanence
answers.why: Negates a face-up Gravekeeper's monster such as Headman, Spiritualist or Descendant before it revives, Fuses or destroys.

answers.name: There Can Be Only One
answers.why: Forces the all-Spellcaster deck down to one monster, stopping Spy, Headman and Rite of Spirit from building a board.

answers.name: Rivalry of Warlords
answers.why: The deck is almost entirely Spellcaster, so it can keep only one monster on the field.

answers.name: Shadow-Imprisoning Mirror
answers.why: Negates the DARK Gravekeeper's monster effects on the field and in the GY, including Headman and Recruiter.

answers.name: Cosmic Cyclone
answers.why: Banishes Necrovalley or Hidden Temples, bypassing Shaman's protection from destruction and turning off the Field Spell and Special Summon lock.

answers.name: Evenly Matched
answers.why: Banishes the protected board face-down instead of destroying it, getting past Supernaturalist and Heretic.

profile.plan: It infects the opponent with Parasite Paracide, turns their monsters into Insects and locks them with Parasite Paranoid while protecting its own board with Union equips and Fusion Parasite.

weaknesses.label: Face-up monster effects
weaknesses.why: Parasite Paracide's FLIP effect, Drill Bug's stacking trigger and Fusion Parasite's Fusion Summon are all face-up monster effects, so negating them stops the engine.

weaknesses.label: Battle damage sets up Paracide
weaknesses.why: Drill Bug only places Parasite Paracide on top of the Deck after it inflicts battle damage, so preventing that damage or the attack stops the setup.

weaknesses.label: Equip Spells on the field
weaknesses.why: Parasite Paranoid and the Metallizing Parasite Unions only lock and protect while they are Equip Spells in the Spell & Trap Zone, so banishing them from the field removes the lock without triggering Paranoid's GY effect.

weaknesses.label: Insect-Type summons and effects
weaknesses.why: Parasite Paracide, Drill Bug, Parasite Paranoid and Fusion Parasite are all Insect, so declaring Insect with Dimensional Barrier stops their Special Summons and negates their on-field effects.

weaknesses.label: Insect-Type swarm
weaknesses.why: Every Parasite monster that matters is Insect, so There Can Be Only One leaves the deck with a single Insect on the field.

weaknesses.label: Equipped end board
weaknesses.why: It ends on monsters equipped with Parasite Paranoid and the Metallizing Parasites, so a board breaker that banishes face-down gets past their protection and Paranoid's GY trigger.

answers.name: Effect Veiler
answers.why: Negates Parasite Paracide after it flips, or Drill Bug and Fusion Parasite before their effects resolve.

answers.name: Infinite Impermanence
answers.why: Negates the face-up Parasite monster whose FLIP, stacking or Fusion Summon effect starts the line.

answers.name: Skill Drain
answers.why: Negates Parasite Paracide, Drill Bug and Fusion Parasite while they are face-up on the field.

answers.name: Waboku
answers.why: Prevents the battle damage Drill Bug needs to place Parasite Paracide on top of the Deck.

answers.name: Cosmic Cyclone
answers.why: Banishes Parasite Paranoid or a Metallizing Parasite while it is an Equip Spell, so it cannot protect or trigger from the GY.

answers.name: Dimensional Barrier
answers.why: Declaring Insect stops Parasite Paracide's Special Summon and negates the effects of the Insect monsters.

answers.name: There Can Be Only One
answers.why: Since its key monsters are Insect, it can only keep one Insect on the field.

answers.name: Evenly Matched
answers.why: Banishes the equipped board face-down, bypassing Union protection and Parasite Paranoid's GY trigger.

profile.plan: Special Summons Level 4 Rock Magnet Warriors from the Deck with Magnet Induction and Epsilon, fills the GY, then banishes or Tributes the named pieces to bring out Berserkion and Valkyrion, ending on Imperion Magnum that negates.

weaknesses.label: Sends and Summons from the Deck
weaknesses.why: Epsilon The Magnet Warrior sends a Magnet Warrior from the Deck to the GY and Magnet Induction Special Summons one from the Deck, so a hand trap that negates Deck effects stops the first play.

weaknesses.label: Monster effects on the field
weaknesses.why: Epsilon's send-and-Special Summon, Berserkion's destruction and Imperion Magnum's negation are all monster effects on the field, so negating a face-up monster's effect stops the payoff.

weaknesses.label: Everything is Tributed for Valkyrion
weaknesses.why: Valkyrion the Magna Warrior must be Special Summoned by Tributing Alpha, Beta and Gamma from the hand or field, and its revival effect Tributes itself, so a floodgate that forbids Tributing shuts off the boss.

weaknesses.label: All monsters are Rock
weaknesses.why: Every Magnet Warrior is a Rock monster, so a floodgate that limits each player to one monster of each Type leaves the deck unable to build a board.

weaknesses.label: Ends on a destruction-protected board
weaknesses.why: Magnet Induction gives the Magnet Warrior and Magna Warrior monsters destruction protection for the turn, so going second you need removal that banishes or returns rather than destroys.

answers.name: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring
answers.why: Negates Epsilon's send from the Deck or Magnet Induction's Special Summon from the Deck.

answers.name: Infinite Impermanence
answers.why: Negates Epsilon or Berserkion on the field.

answers.name: Ghost Belle & Haunted Mansion
answers.why: Negates the GY Special Summon from Epsilon or Valkyrion, or Berserkion's banish from the GY.

answers.name: Dimension Shifter
answers.why: Any card sent to the GY is banished instead, so Epsilon cannot Special Summon from the GY and the GY setup is gone.

answers.name: Mask of Restrict
answers.why: Neither player can Tribute, stopping Valkyrion's Special Summon and revival.

answers.name: There Can Be Only One
answers.why: Each player can only control 1 monster of each Type, and all Magnet Warriors are Rock, so they can only have 1 monster.

answers.name: Evenly Matched
answers.why: Banishes the board face-down at the end of the Battle Phase, bypassing destruction protection.

answers.name: Dark Ruler No More
answers.why: Negates the effects of all face-up monsters the opponent controls, turning off Imperion Magnum's negation and Berserkion's destruction.

profile.plan: Ritual Summons Relinquished and Fusion Summons the Eyes Restrict Fusions, then equips the opponent's monsters to them to gain ATK and protect the boss, ending on a 0-ATK monster holding an opponent's monster as an Equip Spell.

weaknesses.label: Monster effects that equip
weaknesses.why: Relinquished, Thousand-Eyes Restrict, Millennium-Eyes Restrict and Relinquished Anima all equip by monster effect, so negating that effect leaves them at 0 ATK.

weaknesses.label: GY-based Fusion and revival
weaknesses.why: Relinquished Fusion banishes itself from the GY to equip, Illusionist Faceless Magician Special Summons itself from the GY, and Millennium-Eyes Illusionist adds itself from the GY, so banishing or negating those GY effects stops the recursion.

weaknesses.label: All monsters are DARK
weaknesses.why: Every monster in the deck is DARK, so Shadow-Imprisoning Mirror negates the effects of Relinquished, Thousand-Eyes Restrict and the Idols.

weaknesses.label: Ritual Summon by Tributing
weaknesses.why: Black Illusion Ritual Tributes a monster to Ritual Summon Relinquished, so a floodgate that forbids Tributing stops the Ritual.

weaknesses.label: Relies on equipped Spell Cards
weaknesses.why: Relinquished and the Eyes Restrict Fusions only keep their ATK and battle protection while an opponent's monster is equipped as an Equip Spell, so destroying the backrow leaves them at 0 ATK.

answers.name: Effect Veiler
answers.why: Negates Relinquished's or Thousand-Eyes Restrict's equip effect, leaving it at 0 ATK.

answers.name: Infinite Impermanence
answers.why: Negates the first equip effect from Relinquished or an Eyes Restrict Fusion on the field.

answers.name: Ghost Belle & Haunted Mansion
answers.why: Negates Relinquished Fusion's GY banish effect or Illusionist Faceless Magician's revival from the GY.

answers.name: D.D. Crow
answers.why: Banishes Relinquished Fusion or Illusionist Faceless Magician from the GY before their effects can be used.

answers.name: Dark Ruler No More
answers.why: Negates all face-up monster effects, so no equip effects resolve and the boss monsters stay at 0 ATK.

answers.name: Harpie's Feather Duster
answers.why: Destroys the equipped monsters in the Spell & Trap Zone, dropping Relinquished and the Eyes Restrict Fusions to 0 ATK.

answers.name: Shadow-Imprisoning Mirror
answers.why: Negates all DARK monster effects on the field and in the GY, shutting off the whole deck.

answers.name: Mask of Restrict
answers.why: Forbids Tributes, so Black Illusion Ritual cannot Ritual Summon Relinquished.

profile.plan: A pile of unrelated vanillas that wins by Normal Summoning its biggest beater each turn — Cyber-Tech Alligator, Lion Alligator for piercing damage, or Fusion Summoning Alligator's Sword Dragon to attack directly when the opponent's field is all EARTH/WATER/FIRE.

weaknesses.label: Vanilla monsters with no protection
weaknesses.why: Alligator's Sword, Toon Alligator and Cyber-Tech Alligator are Normal Monsters with no protection or negation, so a single mass removal card takes the whole board before it can attack.

weaknesses.label: Its only Fusion boss
weaknesses.why: Alligator's Sword Dragon is the deck's one real payoff and needs "Baby Dragon" plus "Alligator's Sword", so forbidding Fusion Summons leaves it with nothing but vanillas.

weaknesses.label: One Normal Summon per turn
weaknesses.why: Every monster here is Normal Summoned with no way to Summon twice, so negating the Summon of Alligator's Sword or Cyber-Tech Alligator ends its whole turn.

weaknesses.label: Wins only by battle damage
weaknesses.why: Alligator's Sword Dragon attacks directly and Lion Alligator pierces, so stopping attacks and battle damage shuts off every way the deck can win.

weaknesses.label: Mixed Types and Attributes
weaknesses.why: Its monsters are spread over Dragon, Beast, Reptile and Machine and over WIND, EARTH and WATER, so Type and Attribute floodgates stop it from keeping more than one monster on the field.

answers.name: Non-Fusion Area
answers.why: Alligator's Sword Dragon can never be Fusion Summoned, leaving only vanillas.

answers.name: Dimensional Barrier
answers.why: Declaring Fusion stops the Fusion Summon and negates any Fusion Monster's effects.

answers.name: Solemn Warning
answers.why: Negates the one Normal Summon the deck makes each turn.

answers.name: Rivalry of Warlords
answers.why: Its Dragon, Beast, Reptile and Machine monsters cannot be on the field together.

answers.name: Gozen Match
answers.why: Its WIND, EARTH and WATER monsters cannot be on the field together.

answers.name: Messenger of Peace
answers.why: Blocks the attacks of Alligator's Sword Dragon and every beater with 1500 or more ATK.

answers.name: Gravity Bind
answers.why: All of its Level 4 and 5 monsters, including the Fusion, cannot attack.

answers.name: Raigeki
answers.why: Destroys the unprotected Normal Monsters it spent its turns Summoning.

profile.plan: Searches Dark Magician and its support with Dark Magical Circle, Special Summons DARK Spellcasters from the Deck with Dark Magical Curtain, and Fusion Summons Dark Paladin - Wave-Motion using Necromancer of Dragon Magic to negate Spells and attack over the board.

weaknesses.label: Searches and Summons from the Deck
weaknesses.why: Dark Magical Circle adds Dark Magician or a mention card from the Deck and Dark Magical Curtain Special Summons a DARK Spellcaster from the Deck, so a hand trap that negates Deck effects stops the setup.

weaknesses.label: Adds cards repeatedly
weaknesses.why: Dark Magical Circle and Dark Magical Curtain both add cards from the Deck to the hand, so Droll & Lock Bird stops every add after the first.

weaknesses.label: Monster effects on the field
weaknesses.why: Necromancer of Dragon Magic's Fusion Summon and Dark Paladin - Wave-Motion's Spell negation are monster effects on the field, so negating a face-up monster's effect stops the payoff.

weaknesses.label: Fusion materials in the GY
weaknesses.why: Necromancer of Dragon Magic banishes Dark Magician and a Level 7 or higher monster from the GY to Fusion Summon Dark Paladin - Wave-Motion, so a hand trap that negates a banish from the GY stops the Fusion.

weaknesses.label: Ends on Continuous Spell and Equip
weaknesses.why: Dark Magical Circle stays face-up to banish and Armor Wizard Pazoo equips itself as a Spell, so backrow removal such as Harpie's Feather Duster clears the support behind Dark Paladin.

weaknesses.label: Big Fusion boss
weaknesses.why: Dark Paladin - Wave-Motion negates Spell Cards and can attack all monsters, so Trap or monster board breakers that do not activate as Spells get through it.

answers.name: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring
answers.why: Negates Dark Magical Circle's search or Dark Magical Curtain's Special Summon/add from the Deck.

answers.name: Droll & Lock Bird
answers.why: Stops the second search from Dark Magical Circle or Dark Magical Curtain.

answers.name: Infinite Impermanence
answers.why: Negates Necromancer of Dragon Magic or Dark Paladin - Wave-Motion on the field.

answers.name: Effect Veiler
answers.why: Negates Necromancer of Dragon Magic before it Fusion Summons, or Dark Paladin's Spell negation.

answers.name: Ghost Belle & Haunted Mansion
answers.why: Negates Necromancer of Dragon Magic's banish from the GY, stopping the Fusion.

answers.name: Harpie's Feather Duster
answers.why: Destroys Dark Magical Circle and Armor Wizard Pazoo equipped as a Spell.

answers.name: Evenly Matched
answers.why: Forces the opponent to banish most of their board, and as a Trap it is not stopped by Dark Paladin's Spell negation.

answers.name: Lava Golem
answers.why: Tribues Dark Paladin - Wave-Motion and another monster, bypassing its Spell negation.

profile.plan: Stalls behind its signature Equip Spells until it can Summon the Guardians that need them, Ritual Summons Skull Guardian with the Voiceless Voice cards for a negate, and Fusion Summons Guardian Chimera with Polymerization to draw and destroy the opponent's board.

weaknesses.label: Guardians need their Equip Spells
weaknesses.why: Guardian Baou, Guardian Kay'est, Guardian Tryce, Guardian Elma and Guardian Ceal cannot even be Summoned unless their own Equip Spell is face-up, so destroying those Spells leaves them dead in hand.

weaknesses.label: Searches from the Deck
weaknesses.why: Arsenal Summoner's Flip effect adds a Guardian from the Deck, Skull Guardian adds a Voiceless Voice monster from the Deck, and Guardian of the Voiceless Voice Special Summons Skull Guardian from the Deck, so a hand trap that negates Deck effects stops the setup.

weaknesses.label: Monster effects on the field
weaknesses.why: Guardian Chimera's draw-and-destroy, Skull Guardian's Quick Effect negation and Guardian Ceal's destruction all resolve as face-up monster effects, so negating them cuts the deck's payoff.

weaknesses.label: Fusion Summons Guardian Chimera
weaknesses.why: Its biggest play is Fusion Summoning Guardian Chimera with Polymerization, so a card that forbids Fusion Summons leaves it with only small Normal Summoned monsters.

weaknesses.label: Ritual Summons by Tributing
weaknesses.why: Skull Guardian and Skull Guardian, Protector of the Voiceless Voice are Ritual Summoned by Tributing monsters with Prayers of the Voiceless Voice or Novox's Prayer, so a card that forbids Tributes stops the Ritual package and Guardian Tryce's Tribute Summon.

weaknesses.label: Ends on an untargetable Fusion
weaknesses.why: Guardian Chimera cannot be targeted while Polymerization is in the GY and Skull Guardian negates activations, so non-targeting board breakers are the way through going second.

answers.name: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring
answers.why: Negates Arsenal Summoner's search, Skull Guardian's add from the Deck and Guardian of the Voiceless Voice's Special Summon from the Deck.

answers.name: Infinite Impermanence
answers.why: Negates Guardian Chimera's draw-and-destroy or Skull Guardian's Quick Effect negation on the field.

answers.name: Harpie's Feather Duster
answers.why: Destroys every Equip Spell the Guardians need to be Summoned as well as Guardian of the Voiceless Voice.

answers.name: Twin Twisters
answers.why: Destroys two Equip Spells or the Continuous Trap before the Guardians that need them can be Summoned.

answers.name: Evenly Matched
answers.why: Banishes the board without targeting, so Guardian Chimera's Polymerization protection and Skull Guardian's negation do not stop it.

answers.name: Dark Ruler No More
answers.why: Negates Guardian Chimera and Skull Guardian without targeting, leaving the board open to attacks.

answers.name: Non-Fusion Area
answers.why: Neither player can Fusion Summon, so Guardian Chimera can never be made with Polymerization.

answers.name: Mask of Restrict
answers.why: Forbids the Tributes needed for the Skull Guardian Ritual Summons and Guardian Tryce's Tribute Summon.

profile.plan: Stalls attacks with Kuriboh hand and GY effects, then uses Multiply and Kuribabylon to flood the field with Level 1 Fiend Tokens and Linkuriboh, clearing the way with Detonate or Winged Kuriboh LV10.

weaknesses.label: Searches from the Deck
weaknesses.why: The Flute of Summoning Kuriboh, Kuriboo, Kuribee and Kuriboh - Multiply! all add cards from the Deck, so a hand trap that negates that search strips the deck of its setup.

weaknesses.label: Face-up monster effects
weaknesses.why: Detonating Kuriboh's equip-negate, Kuriboh - Multiply!'s search and Linkuriboh's ATK change all activate on the field, so negating a face-up monster stops the disruption.

weaknesses.label: Effects in the GY
weaknesses.why: Linkuriboh, Rainbow Kuriboh, Clear Kuriboh, Kuribohrn and Magikuriboh activate in the GY, so banishing them from the GY removes the protection and recursion.

weaknesses.label: Cards must reach the GY
weaknesses.why: The deck's GY effects need Kuriboh monsters in the GY, so an effect that banishes cards instead of sending them there turns off Linkuriboh, Kuribohrn and Kuribabylon.

weaknesses.label: Tributing its own monsters
weaknesses.why: Multiply, Linkuriboh and the Kuribah/Kuribee/Kuriboo/Kuribeh/Kuriboh Summon all pay costs by Tributing, so a floodgate that forbids Tributes shuts those plays off.

weaknesses.label: One shared monster Type
weaknesses.why: Kuriboh, its Tokens and the Kuribah/Kuribee/Kuriboo/Kuribeh set are all Fiends, so a floodgate allowing only one monster of each Type leaves the deck with a single body.

answers.name: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring
answers.why: Negates Flute of Summoning Kuriboh, Kuriboo or Kuriboh - Multiply! when they add from the Deck.

answers.name: Droll & Lock Bird
answers.why: After the first search it stops Flute of Summoning Kuriboh, Kuriboo, Kuribee and Kuriboh - Multiply! from adding or drawing more.

answers.name: Infinite Impermanence
answers.why: Negates Detonating Kuriboh's equip-negate or Kuriboh - Multiply!'s search and ATK change.

answers.name: D.D. Crow
answers.why: Banishes Linkuriboh, Rainbow Kuriboh or Kuribohrn from the GY before their quick effects can Special Summon them.

answers.name: Dimension Shifter
answers.why: Makes every card that would be sent to the GY be banished instead, turning off the deck's GY protections and Kuribabylon.

answers.name: Macro Cosmos
answers.why: Keeps all cards from reaching the GY, so Linkuriboh, Rainbow Kuriboh and Kuribohrn never get their GY effects.

answers.name: Mask of Restrict
answers.why: Neither player can Tribute, stopping Multiply's cost, Linkuriboh's Tribute and the five-card Kuribabylon Summon.

answers.name: There Can Be Only One
answers.why: Limits them to one Fiend, so the Multiply Tokens and the Level 1 Fiend swarm cannot stay on the field.

profile.plan: It Tribute Summons Level 5 Warrior beaters and a Level 8 multi-attacker, then backs them with a Continuous Spell that searches and flips monsters down and a Continuous Trap that boosts ATK and bounces battle-destroyed monsters.

weaknesses.label: Searches from the Deck
weaknesses.why: The Level 1 monster adds a Spell from the Deck when Summoned and the Continuous Spell adds a Level 5 EARTH Warrior, so a hand trap that negates adds stops the setup.

weaknesses.label: On-field monster effects
weaknesses.why: The Level 1 monster's search and ATK boost and the Level 8's extra-attack effect are face-up monster effects, so negating one ends the turn's payoff.

weaknesses.label: Everything costs a Tribute
weaknesses.why: The Level 8 gains attacks by Tributing Warriors and the Level 1 Tributes itself to Summon a Level 8 from hand, so a floodgate that forbids Tributing shuts both off.

weaknesses.label: All monsters are Warrior
weaknesses.why: Every monster in the deck is a Warrior, so a floodgate limiting each player to one monster of each Type leaves it with a single body.

weaknesses.label: All monsters are EARTH
weaknesses.why: Every monster is EARTH, so an Attribute lock limits it to one monster on the field.

weaknesses.label: Continuous Spell and Trap board
weaknesses.why: The Continuous Spell searches and flips monsters face-down while the Continuous Trap boosts ATK and bounces battle-destroyed monsters, so Spell/Trap removal breaks the setup.

answers.name: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring
answers.why: Negates the Continuous Spell's search or the Level 1 monster's add from the Deck.

answers.name: Droll & Lock Bird
answers.why: After the first search it stops the deck's further adds from the Deck.

answers.name: Effect Veiler
answers.why: Negates the Level 1 monster's search or the Level 8's extra-attack effect on the field.

answers.name: Infinite Impermanence
answers.why: Negates the Level 1 searcher or the Level 8 attacker on the field.

answers.name: Mask of Restrict
answers.why: Neither player can Tribute, stopping the Level 8's extra attacks and the Level 1's Tribute Summon setup.

answers.name: There Can Be Only One
answers.why: All its monsters are Warriors, so it can only keep one monster on the field.

answers.name: Gozen Match
answers.why: All its monsters are EARTH, so it can only keep one monster on the field.

answers.name: Harpie's Feather Duster
answers.why: Destroys the Continuous Spell and Continuous Trap that carry its search and ATK/bounce effects.

profile.plan: Banishes its own monsters so D.D. Survivor, D.D. Scout Plane and D.D. Patrol Plane return in the End Phase, then grinds with D.D. Borderline locking the Battle Phase and D.D. Dynamite burning for each banished card.

weaknesses.label: Relies on banishing its own monsters
weaknesses.why: D.D. Survivor, D.D. Scout Plane and D.D. Patrol Plane only return from the banished zone if they were banished, so a floodgate that forbids banishing stops the whole loop.

weaknesses.label: Banishes during the opponent's turn
weaknesses.why: D.D. Crow, D.D. Seeker and D.D. Sprite banish cards with Quick Effects, so a hand trap that forbids banishing turns them off.

weaknesses.label: Recurs in the banished zone
weaknesses.why: D.D. Survivor, D.D. Scout Plane and D.D. Telepon activate while banished, so negating the effects of banished monsters stops the End Phase returns.

weaknesses.label: Battle Phase lock with Continuous Spell
weaknesses.why: D.D. Borderline stops both players from conducting the Battle Phase while you have no Spells in the GY, so backrow removal is needed to attack.

weaknesses.label: Trap-based burn and lock
weaknesses.why: D.D. Dynamite burns for each banished card and D.D. Post is a Continuous Trap, so negating Trap effects stops the damage and the ATK boost.

answers.name: Imperial Iron Wall
answers.why: Neither player can banish cards, so Survivor, Scout Plane and Patrol Plane never return and Dynamite deals no damage.

answers.name: Artifact Lancea
answers.why: Stops all banishing for the turn, shutting down the End Phase returns and D.D. Crow.

answers.name: Chaos Hunter
answers.why: Your opponent cannot banish cards, which turns off the entire recursion engine.

answers.name: Necrovalley
answers.why: Cards in the GY cannot be banished, stopping D.D. Crow and the GY banishing costs of D.D. Assault Carrier and D.D. Post.

answers.name: Soul Drain
answers.why: Negates the effects of banished monsters, so D.D. Survivor, D.D. Scout Plane and D.D. Telepon no longer return.

answers.name: Harpie's Feather Duster
answers.why: Destroys D.D. Borderline, D.D. Post and Sargasso, unlocking the Battle Phase and stopping the burn support.

answers.name: Twin Twisters
answers.why: Discards a card to destroy D.D. Borderline and D.D. Post before they lock the Battle Phase or boost ATK.

answers.name: Royal Decree
answers.why: Negates D.D. Dynamite's burn and D.D. Post's effects, taking away the deck's win condition.

profile.plan: Discards Thunder Dragon monsters from the hand to search, revive and Fusion Summon, ending on Thunder Dragon Colossus and Thunder Dragon Titan with GY protection.

weaknesses.label: Searches from the Deck
weaknesses.why: Thunder Dragon, Dragondark, Matrix and Thunder Dragon Fusion all add cards from the Deck to the hand, so Ash Blossom negates the first search and Droll & Lock Bird stops the rest.

weaknesses.label: Effects activate in the hand
weaknesses.why: Thunder Dragon, Dragondark, Dragonroar, Dragonhawk and Matrix only start the combo by discarding themselves to activate in the hand, so Mind Drain shuts off every one of them and the Titan/Colossus triggers they feed.

weaknesses.label: Recovers from the GY
weaknesses.why: Dragonroar, Dragonhawk and Hundred Thunders bring cards back from the GY, so Ghost Belle negates those activations before the recursion happens.

weaknesses.label: Relies on banishing its own cards
weaknesses.why: Thunder Dragon Fusion uses face-up banished monsters and Colossus, Titan and Thunderstormech banish from the GY to protect themselves, so Artifact Lancea turns off both the fusion fuel and the protection.

weaknesses.label: Summons many monsters
weaknesses.why: A full combo Special Summons Dragonroar, Colossus, Titan and more, so Nibiru Tributes the whole board after the fifth Summon.

weaknesses.label: Protected Fusion bosses

profile.plan: Synchro-climbs with Machine Tuners and battle-position changes, using Inashichi and Cash Cache to assemble Ninishi into Burei, Bureido and Bureibu while drawing and banishing off each position change.

weaknesses.label: Searches from the Deck
weaknesses.why: Inashichi adds on Normal Summon and Cash Cache adds a Level 4 or lower monster, so Ash Blossom negates the search and leaves the deck without its starter.

weaknesses.label: On-field monster effects
weaknesses.why: Inashichi, Ninishi and Nishipachi use face-up monster effects to start the Synchro climb, so Infinite Impermanence or Effect Veiler negates the first one and the turn stalls.

weaknesses.label: Machine-only lineup
weaknesses.why: Every monster is Machine, so There Can Be Only One leaves the deck with only one monster on the field and stops the Synchro ladder.

weaknesses.label: Machine-Type field and GY
weaknesses.why: Every monster is Machine, so System Down banishes the whole field and GY before the deck can reuse Kuick or Gama Oil.

weaknesses.label: Summons many monsters
weaknesses.why: Ninishi's extra Normal Summon and the Synchro climb Special Summon five or more times, so Nibiru Tributes the board mid-combo.

weaknesses.label: Backrow-supported end board
weaknesses.why: Showdown Castle, Anatomy and Gama Oil sit on the field and Cash Shed/Cash Inn protect the Synchro board, so Evenly Matched banishes the monsters and backrow together.

answers.name: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring
answers.why: Negates Inashichi or Cash Cache's add from the Deck, and also stops Burei/Bureido/Bureibu's Deck Special Summon.

answers.name: Droll & Lock Bird
answers.why: Stops all searches and draws after the first, cutting off Inashichi, Cash Cache, Bureido and Anatomy.

answers.name: Infinite Impermanence
answers.why: Negates Inashichi, Ninishi or Nishipachi on the field, ending the Synchro climb before Burei.

answers.name: Nibiru, the Primal Being
answers.why: Tributers the board after the deck's many Special Summons.

answers.name: System Down
answers.why: Banishes every Machine on the field and in the GY, which is the deck's entire monster lineup.

answers.name: There Can Be Only One
answers.why: All Karakuri are Machine, so it limits each player to one Machine and stops multiple Synchro bodies.

answers.name: Dimensional Barrier
answers.why: Declaring Synchro stops Burei, Bureido and Bureibu from being Special Summoned for the turn.

answers.name: Evenly Matched
answers.why: Banishes the Synchro board plus Showdown Castle, Anatomy, Gama Oil and the Traps at the end of the Battle Phase.

profile.plan: A slow LIGHT Fairy beatdown deck that Tribute Summons Angel O7 to shut off both players' Effect Monster effects, backs it with Counter Traps recycled by Harvest Angel of Wisdom, and grinds value with Guardian Angel Joan's battle Life Point gain and Power Angel Valkyria's search.

weaknesses.label: Searches from the Deck
weaknesses.why: Power Angel Valkyria adds a LIGHT Fairy from the Deck whenever an activation is negated, so a hand trap that negates the add cuts off its only search.

weaknesses.label: Effect monsters on the field
weaknesses.why: Angel O7's gained lock and Power Angel Valkyria's search both sit on face-up monsters, so negating a monster's effect on the field switches them off.

weaknesses.label: Everything is Tribute Summoned
weaknesses.why: Angel O7 and Queen Angel of Roses only work when Tributed out, so a lock on Tributing stops both the lock monster and its removal effect.

weaknesses.label: All its payoff monsters are LIGHT
weaknesses.why: Angel O7, Power Angel Valkyria, Guardian Angel Joan, Harvest Angel of Wisdom and Angel of Zera are all LIGHT, so a floodgate that negates LIGHT monster effects blanks the whole deck at once.

weaknesses.label: Counter Trap backrow
weaknesses.why: Harvest Angel of Wisdom returns Counter Traps from the GY and the deck leans on them for its negations, so backrow removal strips the protection around Angel O7.

answers.name: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring
answers.why: Negates Power Angel Valkyria's add of a LIGHT Fairy from the Deck.

answers.name: Infinite Impermanence
answers.why: Negates Angel O7 the moment it is Tribute Summoned, so its Effect Monster lock never applies.

answers.name: Effect Veiler
answers.why: Negates Power Angel Valkyria or Angel O7 on the field before the search or the lock matters.

answers.name: Dark Ruler No More
answers.why: Negates every face-up monster's effects, turning off Angel O7's lock and all the Fairy payoff effects.

answers.name: Harpie's Feather Duster
answers.why: Clears the Counter Trap backrow that Harvest Angel of Wisdom keeps recycling.

answers.name: Evenly Matched
answers.why: Banishes the Tribute Summoned board and its Set backrow without needing monster effects.

answers.name: Mask of Restrict
answers.why: Neither player can Tribute, so Angel O7 and Queen Angel of Roses can never be Tribute Summoned.

answers.name: Light-Imprisoning Mirror
answers.why: Negates the effects of all LIGHT monsters, which is every payoff card the deck plays.

profile.plan: Summons Gate Guardian by Tributing its three materials, or Fusion Summons by banishing them from the hand, field or GY, ending on Gate Guardians Combined with targeting negation and other Fusions that negate Spell/Traps or search.

weaknesses.label: Relies on banishing materials
weaknesses.why: Every Fusion Summon banishes its three specific materials, so a card that stops banishing prevents all the Fusions.

weaknesses.label: Materials in the GY
weaknesses.why: The Fusions banish their materials from the GY, so banishing one of them from there first stops the Summon.

weaknesses.label: Fusion monsters' Quick Effects
weaknesses.why: The Fusion monsters negate targeting effects, negate Spell/Traps, or search, so negating their effects stops the interaction.

weaknesses.label: Fusion Summons from Extra Deck
weaknesses.why: All the boss monsters are Fusions that must be Special Summoned, so Non-Fusion Area stops them all.

weaknesses.label: Targeting negation
weaknesses.why: The main Fusion negates and destroys any effect that targets, so non-targeting board breakers like Evenly Matched or Dark Ruler No More get through.

weaknesses.label: Searches Spells/Traps
weaknesses.why: One Fusion adds a Spell/Trap from the Deck, so Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring negates that search.

answers.name: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring
answers.why: Negates the search from the Deck by the Thunder and Wind Fusion.

answers.name: D.D. Crow
answers.why: Banishes a material from the GY before it can be used for a Fusion.

answers.name: Called by the Grave
answers.why: Banishes a material from the GY and negates it, stopping the Fusion.

answers.name: Effect Veiler
answers.why: Negates the main Fusion's targeting negation or another Fusion's Quick Effect.

answers.name: Infinite Impermanence
answers.why: Negates a Fusion monster's effect on the field.

answers.name: Dark Ruler No More
answers.why: Negates all the Fusions' effects so they cannot negate your board breakers.

answers.name: Evenly Matched
answers.why: Forces the opponent to banish their board, bypassing the main Fusion's targeting negation.

answers.name: Imperial Iron Wall
answers.why: Prevents the Fusions from banishing materials, stopping all Fusion Summons.

profile.plan: Normal Summons Level 4 DARK Fiends and then Tributes them — either as the Level 8 cost of Curse of the Masked Beast for The Masked Beast, or to Special Summon Masked Beast Des Gardius, whose send-to-GY trigger equips The Mask of Remnants from the Deck and steals an opponent's monster, ending on a 3200/3300 ATK Fiend plus Mask of the Accursed locking attacks.

weaknesses.label: Every monster is a DARK Fiend
weaknesses.why: Grand Tiki Elder, Melchid the Four-Face Beast, Nuvia the Wicked, The Masked Beast and Des Gardius are all DARK Fiends, so a floodgate that lets a player control only 1 Attribute or Type leaves no two bodies to Tribute for Curse of the Masked Beast or for Des Gardius.

weaknesses.label: Both bosses are Special Summon only
weaknesses.why: The Masked Beast exists only through the Ritual Summon of Curse of the Masked Beast and Des Gardius can only be Special Summoned by Tributing 2 monsters, so a floodgate that forbids Special Summons leaves the deck with 1500 ATK Normal Monsters.

weaknesses.label: The Ritual Spell must resolve
weaknesses.why: Curse of the Masked Beast is the only way to The Masked Beast and it must Tribute 8 Levels, so a counter that negates the Spell's activation or the Summon removes the deck's biggest monster.

weaknesses.label: Triggers in the Graveyard
weaknesses.why: Des Gardius equips The Mask of Remnants and steals a monster only when it is sent to the GY, and Mask of Darkness adds a Trap back from the GY, so banishing those cards from the GY takes both payoffs away.

weaknesses.label: Punishes destroying its boss
weaknesses.why: Destroying or Tributing Masked Beast Des Gardius still sends it to the GY and hands the deck The Mask of Remnants to steal your monster, so going second you need a board breaker that banishes the field face-down instead.

answers.name: Gozen Match
answers.why: All of its monsters are DARK, so it can never keep two on the field to Tribute for the Ritual or for Des Gardius.

answers.name: Rivalry of Warlords
answers.why: All of its monsters are Fiends, so it is stuck with one monster and cannot pay either Tribute cost.

answers.name: There Can Be Only One
answers.why: Every monster it plays is a Fiend, so it is limited to a single body and cannot Tribute Summon or Ritual Summon.

answers.name: Solemn Warning
answers.why: Negates the activation of Curse of the Masked Beast or the Special Summon of Masked Beast Des Gardius.

answers.name: D.D. Crow
answers.why: Banishes Des Gardius from the GY in response to its trigger, so The Mask of Remnants never equips and no monster is stolen.

answers.name: Called by the Grave
answers.why: Banishes a Fiend from its GY and negates it, stopping Des Gardius's Remnants steal or Mask of Darkness's Trap recovery.

answers.name: Dimension Shifter
answers.why: Everything goes to banishment instead of the GY, so Des Gardius never triggers and Mask of Darkness has no Traps to recover.

answers.name: Evenly Matched
answers.why: Banishes the Ritual Monster, Des Gardius and the Equip Spells face-down, so nothing is sent to the GY and Remnants never comes out.

weaknesses.label: Monster effects on the field

weaknesses.label: Many Special Summons

weaknesses.label: Winged Beast only

weaknesses.label: Trap-based disruption

weaknesses.label: Protected end board
weaknesses.why: Pet Phantasmal Dragon blocks targeting and Triangle Ecstasy resists non-WIND monster effects, so non-targeting board breakers clear the board.

answers.name: Red Reboot

weaknesses.label: Ends on an untargetable negating Fusion
weaknesses.why: Red-Eyes Fusion brings out Red-Eyes Dark Dragoon, which cannot be targeted or destroyed and negates with a discard, so non-targeting board breakers and Tributes are needed to clear it.

weaknesses.label: Revival Traps and Equip Spells
weaknesses.why: Return of the Red-Eyes and Red-Eyes Spirit revive from the GY while Red-Eyes Fang with Chain equips, so backrow removal strips the deck of its recursion and protection.

answers.name: Infinite Impermanence
answers.why: Negates Red-Eyes Darkness Metal Dragon or Red-Eyes Soul on the field.

answers.name: D.D. Crow

answers.name: Called by the Grave
answers.why: Banishes a key Red-Eyes from the GY and negates its effect.

answers.name: Evenly Matched

answers.name: Gameciel, the Sea Turtle Kaiju
answers.why: Tributing Red-Eyes Dark Dragoon gets around its untargetable and indestructible protection.

profile.plan: Uses Elemental Saga Doriado to Special Summon itself and a GY monster, then Special Summons from the Deck, building toward Elemental Grace Doriado, which negates Summons by banishing 3 monsters from the GY.

weaknesses.label: Different Attributes in the GY
weaknesses.why: Elemental Saga Doriado needs 3+ different Attributes in the GY to Summon itself, and Elemental Grace Doriado needs 6+, so banishing a key monster from the GY with a hand trap turns both off.

weaknesses.label: Cards never reach the GY
weaknesses.why: Elemental Saga Doriado and Elemental Grace Doriado count Attributes in the GY, so effects that banish cards instead of sending them to the GY leave the deck with no fuel.

weaknesses.label: All monsters are Spellcaster
weaknesses.why: Every Doriado monster is a Spellcaster, so There Can Be Only One limits the deck to a single monster on the field.

weaknesses.label: Relies on Special Summons
weaknesses.why: Elemental Saga Doriado and Elemental Grace Doriado are only Summoned by Special Summon, so a floodgate that forbids Special Summoning stops the whole deck.

weaknesses.label: Grace Doriado's negation
weaknesses.why: Elemental Grace Doriado's Quick Effect negates Summons by banishing 3 monsters from the GY, so negating that monster's effect leaves the board open.

weaknesses.label: Ritual Summon
weaknesses.why: Elemental Mistress Doriado can only be Ritual Summoned with Doriado's Blessing, so negating the Ritual Spell or the Summon stops it.

answers.name: Dimension Shifter
answers.why: Prevents any card from reaching the GY, so no different Attributes accumulate for Elemental Saga Doriado or Elemental Grace Doriado.

answers.name: D.D. Crow
answers.why: Banishes a key Attribute from the GY, dropping the count below 3 or 6.

answers.name: Bystial Magnamhut
answers.why: Banishes a LIGHT Doriado monster from the GY and Special Summons itself, breaking the Attribute count.

answers.name: Necrovalley
answers.why: Stops cards being banished from the GY and negates effects that move cards from the GY, so Elemental Saga Doriado cannot Summon and Elemental Grace Doriado cannot pay its cost.

answers.name: There Can Be Only One
answers.why: All Doriado monsters are Spellcaster, so this limits the deck to one monster.

answers.name: Vanity's Emptiness
answers.why: Forbids all Special Summons, stopping Elemental Saga Doriado and Elemental Grace Doriado from ever hitting the field.

answers.name: Effect Veiler
answers.why: Negates Elemental Grace Doriado's Quick Effect, so its Summon negation is gone.

answers.name: Evenly Matched
answers.why: Banishes the board at the end of the Battle Phase, clearing Elemental Grace Doriado and any other monsters.

profile.plan: The deck does nothing but draw: Pot of Greed, Desires, Duality, Prosperity and Extravagance dig through the Deck for more draw cards and Set Trap draws, ending on nothing but a Set Pot of The Forbidden and a wall of face-down Traps.

weaknesses.label: Wins purely by drawing
weaknesses.why: Pot of Greed, Pot of Desires, Reckless Greed and Jar of Greed exist only to draw cards, so a lock that forbids drawing leaves the deck with no play at all.

weaknesses.label: Everything is a Normal Spell
weaknesses.why: Pot of Greed, Pot of Desires, Pot of Duality, Pot of Prosperity and Pot of Extravagance are all Normal Spells, so a lock that makes Spells be Set before they can resolve stops every one of them.

weaknesses.label: Uses cards from the Deck
weaknesses.why: Pot of Duality and Pot of Prosperity excavate and add a card from the Deck and Pot of Desires banishes from the Deck, so a hand trap that negates a Deck-based effect blanks the draw spell before it resolves.

weaknesses.label: Shuffles the GY back to draw
weaknesses.why: Pot of Avarice, Jar of Avarice, Pot of Dichotomy and Pot of Riches only draw if cards can leave the GY, so a card that locks the GY leaves nothing to shuffle.

weaknesses.label: Its only defence is Set Traps
weaknesses.why: Reckless Greed, Jar of Greed, Jar of Avarice and The Gift of Greed are Set face-down as the deck's entire interaction, so Spell/Trap removal clears the whole board at once.

weaknesses.label: Draws with Trap Cards
weaknesses.why: Reckless Greed, Jar of Greed and Jar of Avarice are chained during your own turn to draw, so a card that negates Trap activations cuts the engine while you are playing.

answers.name: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring
answers.why: Negates Pot of Desires' banishing from the Deck, Pot of Duality's addition and Pot of Prosperity's excavation, so the draw spell resolves for nothing.

answers.name: Solemn Judgment
answers.why: Negates the activation of Pot of Greed, Pot of Desires or Pot of Duality before a single card is drawn.

answers.name: Red Reboot
answers.why: Negates Reckless Greed or Jar of Greed and shuts off every Trap for the rest of the turn, blanking the deck's draw engine.

answers.name: Anti-Spell Fragrance
answers.why: Forces every Pot and Jar Spell to be Set and wait a turn, so none of the deck's Normal Spells ever resolve.

answers.name: Protector of the Sanctuary
answers.why: The opponent can no longer draw outside the Draw Phase, so Pot of Greed, Pot of Desires, Reckless Greed and Jar of Greed achieve nothing.

answers.name: Necrovalley
answers.why: Locks the GY, so Pot of Avarice, Jar of Avarice, Pot of Dichotomy and Pot of Riches have no cards to shuffle back.

answers.name: Harpie's Feather Duster
answers.why: Destroys the Set Reckless Greed, Jar of Greed and Jar of Avarice that are the deck's only defence.

answers.name: Evenly Matched
answers.why: Banishes all but one of the deck's Set Traps and its Set Pot of The Forbidden at the end of the Battle Phase.

profile.plan: Swarms Level 3–5 WATER Fish monsters by Special Summoning them from the hand and Deck, then Xyz Summons WATER Xyz Monsters such as Number C32: Shark Drake Veiss and Shark Fortress, with Veiss Shark as material granting Spell/Trap negation.

weaknesses.why: Veiss Shark Special Summons a Fish Shark from the Deck and Shark Cruiser Special Summons WATER monsters from the Deck, while Hydrojet Shark sends from the Deck to the GY, so a hand trap that negates Deck effects cuts the engine at its start.

weaknesses.label: Monster effects on the field

weaknesses.label: Ends on a WATER Xyz board
weaknesses.why: Going second you face Number C32: Shark Drake Veiss and Shark Fortress with Veiss Shark's Spell/Trap negation attached, so non-targeting board breakers are needed to clear it.

answers.name: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring
answers.why: Negates Veiss Shark's Special Summon from the Deck, Shark Cruiser's Summon from the Deck, or Hydrojet Shark's send from the Deck to the GY.

answers.name: Infinite Impermanence
answers.why: Negates Veiss Shark, Hydrojet Shark or Cutter Shark on the field before the Xyz Summon.

answers.name: Effect Veiler
answers.why: Negates the first Shark monster's effect on the field, stopping the combo's start.

answers.name: Nibiru, the Primal Being
answers.why: Tributes the whole board once the combo has Summoned five or more monsters.

answers.name: D.D. Crow
answers.why: Banishes Crystal Shark, Dream Shark or Cutter Shark from the GY before its effect can be used.

answers.name: Called by the Grave
answers.why: Banishes a Shark monster in the GY and negates its effect, cutting the recursion.

answers.name: Dark Ruler No More
answers.why: Negates every face-up monster effect the deck's Xyz board relies on for the turn.

answers.name: Evenly Matched

weaknesses.label: Mono-WATER Fish board

weaknesses.label: End board and Continuous backrow
weaknesses.why: It ends on White Aura Bihamut with Tokens plus White Reincarnation and Arbitration of White, so a board breaker like Evenly Matched clears the monsters and the Continuous Spell/Trap.

answers.name: Nibiru, the Primal Being
answers.why: Tributates the board once the Synchro climb has Summoned five or more times.

profile.plan: This is a pile of vanilla Normal Monsters: it Normal and Tribute Summons Level 5–6 beaters like B. Dragon Jungle King, Royal Guard and Rock Spirit and tries to win by attacking over the opponent, ending on a board of ordinary monsters with no effects, negation or protection.

weaknesses.label: Board of plain monsters
weaknesses.why: B. Dragon Jungle King, Royal Guard, Rock Spirit and every other card here is a Normal Monster with no protection or floating, so a board wipe like Raigeki or Dark Hole clears the whole field going second.

weaknesses.label: No protection on the field
weaknesses.why: Nothing in the deck negates or protects, so an untargeted board breaker such as Evenly Matched strips the Normal Monsters and any Set backrow without resistance.

weaknesses.label: Wins only by attacking
weaknesses.why: The deck has no burn, no alternate win and no effect damage; it must attack with its Normal Monsters, so a battle trap like Mirror Force or Dimensional Prison punishes the attack and removes the attackers.

weaknesses.label: Tributes for its big monsters
weaknesses.why: B. Dragon Jungle King, Crow Goblin, Ill Witch, Leo Wizard, Winged Egg of New Life, Machine Attacker and Rock Spirit are Level 5–6 and need Tributes, so a floodgate like Mask of Restrict stops them ever being Tribute Summoned.

weaknesses.label: Only Normal Summons
weaknesses.why: With no effects the deck cannot Special Summon, so every monster reaches the field by Normal or Tribute Summon and a card that negates the Summon, such as Solemn Warning, stops the play before it lands.

answers.name: Raigeki
answers.why: Destroys every Normal Monster the deck has on the field, since none of them have any protection.

answers.name: Dark Hole
answers.why: Clears the whole board of vanilla beaters in one card.

answers.name: Lightning Storm
answers.why: Mass removal that wipes the unprotected Normal Monster board going second.

answers.name: Evenly Matched
answers.why: Banishes the monsters and any Set backrow wholesale, since nothing here negates it.

answers.name: Torrential Tribute
answers.why: Responds to the Normal or Tribute Summon and destroys every monster the deck just committed.

answers.name: Mirror Force
answers.why: Punishes the attack the deck has to make and destroys all its attacking monsters.

answers.name: Solemn Warning
answers.why: Negates the Normal Summon or Tribute Summon of its Level 5–6 beaters before they hit the field.

answers.name: Mask of Restrict
answers.why: Neither player can Tribute, so the Level 5–6 monsters can never be Tribute Summoned.

profile.plan: Sets Penguin monsters face-down to use Flip effects that return the opponent's cards to the hand, Synchro Summons Penguin Brave to protect them and flip them face-up, and uses Nopenguin to banish the returned cards.

weaknesses.label: Searches from the Deck
weaknesses.why: Royal Penguins Garden and First Penguin add cards from the Deck to the hand, so a hand trap that negates the search stops the setup.

weaknesses.label: Special Summons from the Deck
weaknesses.why: The Great Emperor Penguin and Penguin Brave Special Summon Penguin monsters from the Deck, so a hand trap that negates the Special Summon stops the board.

weaknesses.label: Graveyard recursion
weaknesses.why: Nopenguin, Puny Penguin and Penguin Cleric Special Summon themselves or other Penguin monsters from the GY, so a card that attacks the GY stops the recursion.

weaknesses.label: Face-down Defense Position monsters
weaknesses.why: Penguin Soldier, Nightmare Penguin and Penguin Ninja need to be flipped face-up to use their effects, so banishing them while face-down with Nobleman of Crossout stops the Flip effect.

weaknesses.label: Sets monsters face-down
weaknesses.why: Penguin Squire, Penguin Ninja and Penguin Brave place monsters in face-down Defense Position, so a floodgate that forbids setting stops the Flip engine.

weaknesses.label: Protected face-down board
weaknesses.why: Penguin Brave prevents targeting face-down Defense Position monsters, so non-targeting board breakers like Evenly Matched or Dark Ruler No More get through.

profile.plan: A straightforward Warrior beatdown deck that Normal Summons 1400-2100 ATK Celtic Guards, uses Celtic Guard of Noble Arms to Special Summon from the hand and draw cards off battle damage, and leans on Obnoxious Celtic Guard's immunity to battle destruction to keep attacking.

weaknesses.label: Effects on the field
weaknesses.why: Celtic Guard of Noble Arms Special Summons from the hand and draws off battle damage, and Obnoxious Celtic Guard's battle immunity, are all face-up monster effects, so negating a monster's effect on the field turns off whichever one is doing the work.

weaknesses.label: Only wins through battle
weaknesses.why: Celtic Guard of Noble Arms only draws after it inflicts battle damage and Obnoxious Celtic Guard only matters while attacking or being attacked, so anything that stops monsters from attacking leaves the deck with no way to make progress.

weaknesses.label: Special Summons from the hand
weaknesses.why: Celtic Guard of Noble Arms is the deck's only way to put a second body on board, Special Summoning a Celtic Guard from the hand, so a floodgate that forbids Special Summoning leaves a single 2100 ATK monster that cannot even attack while holding cards.

weaknesses.label: Battle protection only
weaknesses.why: Obnoxious Celtic Guard stops destruction by battle but nothing in the deck stops destruction by card effects, so mass removal clears the whole field of Celtic Guards at once.

weaknesses.label: Small board, no negation
weaknesses.why: The deck ends on a single 2100 ATK Celtic Guard of Noble Arms plus at most a battle-protected Obnoxious Celtic Guard and has no way to negate anything, so one board breaker going second dismantles everything it built.

answers.name: Evenly Matched

weaknesses.label: Needs cards to reach the GY

profile.plan: Ritual Summons using Djinn Ritual monsters banished from the GY as material, then protects that Ritual monster with Djinn Releaser of Rituals' Special Summon lock or Demolisher/Disserere protection, while Xyz Summoning Rank 3 and 4 Djinn Xyz monsters for negation and removal.

weaknesses.why: Djinn Releaser of Rituals, Djinn Demolisher of Rituals, Djinn Disserere of Rituals and the other Ritual Djinns are banished from the GY as the material for a Ritual Summon, so a card that forbids banishing leaves the Ritual Summon with no material.

weaknesses.label: Ritual Summons

weaknesses.label: Xyz Djinn monster effects

weaknesses.label: Untargetable protected Ritual
weaknesses.why: Djinn Demolisher of Rituals makes the Ritual monster untargetable and Djinn Disserere of Rituals makes it unaffected by Traps, so non-targeting board breakers such as Evenly Matched are needed to clear it.

weaknesses.label: Rank 3 and Rank 4 Xyz Summons

profile.plan: Climbs Tuners into DARK Dragon Synchro Monsters, ending on Hot Red Dragon Archfiend King Calamity and Hot Red Dragon Archfiend Abyss locking the opponent out and negating, with Tyrant Red Dragon Archfiend as back-up removal.

weaknesses.label: Sends Tuners from the Deck
weaknesses.why: Bone Archfiend sends a Fiend Tuner from the Deck to the GY and Masterking Archfiend sends a Fiend from the Deck to the GY, so a hand trap that negates that send cuts the Tuner the Synchro climb needs.

weaknesses.label: Monster effects on the field
weaknesses.why: Abyss's Quick Effect negation, Bane's Tribute-to-revive and King Calamity's lock are all monster effects, so negating a face-up monster stops the payoff before it resolves.

weaknesses.label: Summons five or more times
weaknesses.why: A full climb through Scarred Dragon Archfiend, Bane and King Calamity Special Summons five or more monsters, so cards that punish that many Summons wipe the board before the end board exists.

weaknesses.label: Synchro Summons from the Extra Deck
weaknesses.why: Abyss, Bane, King Calamity, Tyrant and Red Nova are all Synchro Summoned in one turn, so a card that declares Synchro and forbids those Special Summons stops the entire Extra Deck.

weaknesses.label: Revives from the Graveyard
weaknesses.why: Bone Archfiend Special Summons itself from the GY and Abyss and Bane revive Tuners from the GY, so banishing or negating those GY cards takes away the follow-up material.

weaknesses.label: Ends on negating Synchro bosses
weaknesses.why: Going second you face King Calamity, Abyss and Tyrant with their negation and destruction, so board breakers that clear or blank them without being negated are what gets through.

answers.name: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring
answers.why: Negates Bone Archfiend's or Masterking Archfiend's send from the Deck to the GY, leaving no Tuner to Synchro with.

answers.name: Infinite Impermanence
answers.why: Negates Bone Archfiend or the Synchro Monster whose Quick Effect would negate or destroy.

answers.name: Nibiru, the Primal Being
answers.why: Tributes the whole board once the climb has Summoned five or more monsters, before King Calamity locks the turn.

answers.name: Dimensional Barrier
answers.why: Declaring Synchro stops every Synchro Summon the deck's end board is made of.

answers.name: Called by the Grave
answers.why: Banishes Bone Archfiend or a Tuner from the GY and negates it, cutting the revival plays.

answers.name: Ghost Belle & Haunted Mansion
answers.why: Negates the GY effects that Special Summon Bone Archfiend or revive Tuners for the next Synchro.

answers.name: Evenly Matched
answers.why: Banishes the King Calamity and Abyss board face-down at the end of the Battle Phase.

answers.name: Forbidden Droplet
answers.why: Sends cards to the GY to blank the Synchro Monsters' negation and destruction effects before committing to the board.

profile.plan: Tribute Summons and Special Summons big monsters like Tyler the Great Warrior, Lord of Darkness and Demiurge Ema, then wins by battle with high ATK and burn from Lord of Darkness's Tokens and Tyler's damage effect.

weaknesses.label: Tributes its own monsters
weaknesses.why: Lord of Darkness Special Summons itself by Tributing 2 Fiend or Fairy monsters and Tyler the Great Warrior is a Tribute Summon, so a card that forbids Tributing shuts both down.

weaknesses.label: Sends from the Deck to the GY
weaknesses.why: Demiurge Ema's first effect sends 4 monsters from the hand, Deck, or field to the GY to Special Summon itself, so a hand trap that negates that send stops the Summon.

weaknesses.label: Swarms Fiend Tokens
weaknesses.why: Lord of Darkness's once-per-turn effect Special Summons as many Lord of Darkness Tokens as possible, so a card that reacts to a Token being Special Summoned destroys them all.

weaknesses.label: Monster effects on the field
weaknesses.why: Lord of Darkness's Token Summon and Demiurge Ema's destruction effect are activated monster effects, so negating a face-up monster's effect stops the payoff.

weaknesses.label: Special Summons five or more times
weaknesses.why: A full combo with Lord of Darkness Special Summons itself and then up to five Tokens, so Nibiru can Tribute the whole board.

weaknesses.label: No effect protection on its bosses
weaknesses.why: Tyler, Lord of Darkness and Demiurge Ema have no protection from card effects, so mass removal clears the board going second.

answers.name: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring
answers.why: Negates Demiurge Ema's effect that sends 4 monsters from the Deck to the GY to Special Summon itself.

answers.name: Infinite Impermanence
answers.why: Negates Lord of Darkness's Token Summon and its battle protection, or Demiurge Ema's on-field destruction effect.

answers.name: Effect Veiler
answers.why: Negates Lord of Darkness's Token Summon or Demiurge Ema's on-field effect.

answers.name: Nibiru, the Primal Being
answers.why: Tributues the whole board after Lord of Darkness and its Tokens have Summoned five or more monsters.

answers.name: Token Collector
answers.why: Special Summons itself and destroys all Tokens the moment Lord of Darkness Summons one.

answers.name: Mask of Restrict
answers.why: Neither player can Tribute, stopping Lord of Darkness's Special Summon and Tyler's Tribute Summon.

answers.name: There Can Be Only One
answers.why: Limits each player to one Fiend, stopping the Lord of Darkness Token swarm and multiple Fiends.

answers.name: Evenly Matched
answers.why: Banishes the whole board, including Lord of Darkness and its Tokens, at the end of the Battle Phase.

profile.plan: Dark Magician searches and Summons Dark Magician with Magician's Rod and Magicians' Souls, then protects it with Eternal Soul and negates with Magicians' Combination, ending on an unaffected Dark Magician and often Dark Magician the Dragon Knight.

weaknesses.label: Searches from the Deck
weaknesses.why: Magician's Rod, Apprentice Illusion Magician, Illusion Magic, Magician's Salvation and Bond Between Teacher and Student all add or Special Summon from the Deck, so a hand trap that negates that stops the first play.

weaknesses.label: Monster effects on the field
weaknesses.why: Magician's Rod, Magicians' Souls, Magician of Dark Illusion and Magician's Robe start the combo with effects on the field, so negating a face-up monster's effect ends the turn early.

weaknesses.label: All monsters are Spellcasters
weaknesses.why: Every main deck monster is a Spellcaster, so a floodgate that limits each player to one monster of each Type leaves them with only one monster on the field.
phrases: only control 1 monster of each Type

weaknesses.label: Relies on Eternal Soul
weaknesses.why: Eternal Soul protects Dark Magician and revives it, but it is a Continuous Trap, so removing or negating it (or banishing it without targeting) turns off the protection and its leave-field effect destroys all their monsters.

weaknesses.label: Unaffected Dark Magician
weaknesses.why: Eternal Soul makes Dark Magician unaffected by opponent's card effects, so only cards that Tribute it (Kaiju) or remove the Trap can out it.

answers.name: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring
answers.why: Negates Magician's Rod's search, Magicians' Souls' Deck send, and Magician's Salvation's Set from Deck.

answers.name: Droll & Lock Bird
answers.why: Stops every search and draw after the first, which starves the deck's searching engine.

answers.name: Infinite Impermanence
answers.why: Negates Magician's Rod or Magicians' Souls on the field before they start the combo.

answers.name: Effect Veiler
answers.why: Negates the first on-field monster effect, usually Magician's Rod or Magicians' Souls.

answers.name: Evenly Matched
answers.why: Banishes the board face-down including Eternal Soul, which then destroys all their monsters.

answers.name: There Can Be Only One
answers.why: Since every main deck monster is a Spellcaster, they are limited to one monster on the field.

answers.name: Royal Decree
answers.why: Negates Eternal Soul's protection and revival and Magicians' Combination's negation.

answers.name: Lava Golem
answers.why: Tributing bypasses Eternal Soul's effect protection to remove the unaffected Dark Magician and another monster.

profile.plan: A control shell of Quick-Play 'Book' Spells that flips the opponent's monsters face-down to blank their attacks and effects, then revives a Zombie from the GY and chips in battle damage with an equipped Spellcaster.

weaknesses.label: Plays out of the Graveyard
weaknesses.why: The only way the deck puts a monster on the field is a Spell that Special Summons a Zombie from the GY and banishes a monster in the opponent's GY, so banishing those GY cards or locking the GY leaves it with no monster at all.

weaknesses.label: Every card is a Spell
weaknesses.why: The deck has no monsters, Traps or protection of its own — every flip effect it relies on is a Spell Card activation, so negating a Spell activation blanks the whole turn.

weaknesses.label: Spells must be played from hand
weaknesses.why: Its face-down flips are Quick-Play Spells that only work by being activated from the hand on the opponent's turn, so a lock that forces Spells to be Set first takes away its entire interaction.

weaknesses.label: Small backrow-based board
weaknesses.why: Going second the deck's whole setup is one monster carrying an Equip Spell plus a few Set Quick-Play Spells, so clearing the Spell & Trap Zone removes both its stat boost and its flipping defence.

answers.name: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring
answers.why: Negates the GY Special Summon and the GY banish of the revival Spell, leaving the deck with no monster.

answers.name: Ghost Belle & Haunted Mansion
answers.why: Negates the effect that Special Summons from the GY and banishes a card from the GY.

answers.name: D.D. Crow
answers.why: Banishes the Zombie sitting in the GY so the revival Spell has no target.

answers.name: Necrovalley
answers.why: Cards in the GY cannot be moved, so both the revival and its GY banish do nothing.

answers.name: Anti-Spell Fragrance
answers.why: Forces every Spell to be Set first, so the Quick-Play flips cannot be used on the opponent's turn.

answers.name: Spell Canceller
answers.why: Negates all Spell effects, which turns off every card the deck has.

answers.name: Solemn Judgment
answers.why: Negates the activation of any of its Spells, including the mass flip and the revival.

answers.name: Harpie's Feather Duster
answers.why: Destroys the Equip Spell and every Set Quick-Play the deck is holding on the field.

profile.plan: Sits on a wall of Set Trap Holes that answer every Summon one-for-one — Bottomless Trap Hole destroys and banishes, Floodgate Trap Hole flips face-down, Time-Space Trap Hole shuffles back — grinding the opponent out while Dark Hole Dragon and Traptrix Holeutea keep bodies on the field.

weaknesses.label: Everything sits in the backrow
weaknesses.why: Bottomless Trap Hole, Floodgate Trap Hole, Treacherous Trap Hole and Network Trap Hole only work as Set cards in the Spell & Trap Zone, so a card that wipes or returns backrow removes the entire game plan before it can answer a Summon.

weaknesses.label: Traps negated as they activate
weaknesses.why: Every Trap Hole only works by activating a Normal Trap in response to a Summon, so a card that negates the activation of a Trap Card stops Bottomless Trap Hole, Floodgate Trap Hole and Time-Space Trap Hole outright.

weaknesses.label: Face-up Trap effects
weaknesses.why: The deck's only interaction is face-up Trap Cards on the field, so a continuous lock that negates Trap effects turns off Bottomless Trap Hole, Floodgate Trap Hole and the rest at once.

weaknesses.label: Traps have to be Set first
weaknesses.why: Every Trap Hole must be Set before it can be used, and Traptrix Holeutea is the only one that can be activated the turn it is Set, so a lock that forbids Setting or activating Set Spell/Traps leaves the whole deck dead in hand.

answers.name: Red Reboot
answers.why: Negates the activation of Bottomless Trap Hole or Floodgate Trap Hole and stops every other Trap the deck controls for the rest of the turn.

answers.name: Harpie's Feather Duster
answers.why: Destroys every Set Trap Hole at once before any of them can respond to a Summon.

answers.name: Lightning Storm
answers.why: Wipes the Set backrow without targeting, leaving the deck with no Holes to answer a Summon.

answers.name: Evenly Matched
answers.why: Forces the Trap player to banish their entire Set backrow and any monsters at the end of the Battle Phase.

answers.name: Denko Sekka
answers.why: Stops the deck Setting new Trap Holes and stops already-Set Traps from being activated, so no Hole can fire.

answers.name: Royal Decree
answers.why: Negates every other Trap effect on the field, turning off all the Trap Holes for as long as it stays.

answers.name: Jinzo
answers.why: Trap Cards cannot be activated while it is on the field, so Bottomless Trap Hole and Floodgate Trap Hole never resolve.

answers.name: Wiretap
answers.why: Negates a Trap Hole's activation and shuffles it back into the Deck so that copy cannot be reused.

profile.plan: Fusion Summons Gaia the Magical Knight of Dragons and Sky Galloping Gaia the Dragon Champion with Galloping Gaia and Spiral Fusion, then attacks with piercing and double attacks while Galloping Gaia stops the opponent activating during the Battle Phase.

weaknesses.label: Searches and summons from the Deck
weaknesses.why: Galloping Gaia adds a Level 5 Dragon or Gaia from the Deck and Artillery Catapult Turtle Special Summons one from the Deck, so Ash Blossom negates the play that assembles the Fusion.

weaknesses.label: Adds cards to the hand
weaknesses.why: Galloping Gaia, Curse of Dragon, the Cursed Dragon, Charging Gaia and the Gaia Knights all add cards to the hand, so Droll & Lock Bird stops every add after the first.

weaknesses.label: Monster effects on the field
weaknesses.why: Gaia the Magical Knight of Dragons destroys a card with its Quick Effect and Heart of Gaia negates monster effects, so negating a face-up monster stops the interaction.

weaknesses.label: Fusion Summon based
weaknesses.why: Spiral Fusion and Gaia the Magical Knight of Dragons need Fusion Summons using Gaia and a Level 5 Dragon, so a floodgate that forbids Fusion Summon stops the deck's payoff.

weaknesses.label: Ends on Field Spell and Continuous Traps
weaknesses.why: Galloping Gaia and Spiral Discharge/Spear Strike sit in the Spell & Trap Zone and carry the Battle Phase lock and destruction, so backrow removal breaks the board before the OTK.

answers.why: Negates Galloping Gaia's search or Artillery Catapult Turtle's Special Summon from the Deck.

answers.name: Droll & Lock Bird
answers.why: Stops the repeated adds from Galloping Gaia, Curse of Dragon and Charging Gaia after the first search.

answers.name: Infinite Impermanence
answers.why: Negates Artillery Catapult Turtle, Gaia the Magical Knight, or Gaia the Magical Knight of Dragons.

answers.name: Effect Veiler
answers.why: Negates the first key monster effect on the field, such as Gaia the Magical Knight or Heart of Gaia.

answers.name: Ghost Ogre & Snow Rabbit
answers.why: Destroys Galloping Gaia when it activates its search effect, or Spiral Fusion when it is activated.

answers.name: Harpie's Feather Duster
answers.why: Clears Galloping Gaia, Spiral Spear Strike and Spiral Discharge so the Battle Phase lock and protection are gone.

answers.name: Dark Ruler No More
answers.why: Negates Gaia the Magical Knight of Dragons and Heart of Gaia going second without targeting.

answers.name: Non-Fusion Area
answers.why: Forbids both players from Fusion Summoning, stopping Spiral Fusion and Gaia the Magical Knight of Dragons.

profile.plan: Sets Pendulum Scales with Luster Pendulum and Majesty Pegasus, Pendulum Summons multiple monsters, and ends on Master Peace's once-per-turn negation with Dinoster Power protecting the board.

weaknesses.label: Searches from the Deck
weaknesses.why: Majesty Pegasus, Ignis Phoenix and Luster Pendulum add cards from the Deck to the hand, so Ash Blossom negates the search and leaves the deck without its scales or extenders.

weaknesses.label: Monster effects on the field
weaknesses.why: Master Peace negates activations, Ignister Prominence destroys and shuffles, and Wind Unicorn bounces, so Infinite Impermanence or Effect Veiler negating a face-up monster stops the interaction.

weaknesses.label: Pendulum Scales are Spell Cards
weaknesses.why: Luster Pendulum, Master Pendulum and Majesty Pegasus are activated in the Pendulum Zone as Spell Cards to set scales, so Harpie's Feather Duster destroys both scales and stops the Pendulum Summon.

weaknesses.label: Pendulum Summoning
weaknesses.why: The deck needs to activate Pendulum Monsters as Spell Cards in the Pendulum Zone to Pendulum Summon, so Anti-Spell Fragrance forces those Spell Cards to be Set first and delays the engine by a turn.

weaknesses.label: Summons many monsters
weaknesses.why: A full combo Pendulum Summons several monsters and then uses them for Synchro, Xyz and Fusion Summons, so Nibiru Tributes the board once five or more monsters have been Summoned.

weaknesses.label: Ends on a negation board
weaknesses.why: Going second you face Master Peace's once-per-turn negation and Dinoster Power's destruction protection, so Dark Ruler No More negates all those monster effects and prevents a response.

answers.why: Negates the searches from the Deck by Majesty Pegasus, Ignis Phoenix or Luster Pendulum, and the Special Summon from the Deck of Draco Face-Off.

answers.name: Droll & Lock Bird
answers.why: Stops every search after the first, which cuts off the second Pendulum Scale and the Dracoverlord pieces.

answers.name: Infinite Impermanence
answers.why: Negates Master Peace's negation or the first Dracoslayer monster effect on the field.

answers.name: Effect Veiler
answers.why: Negates a face-up Dracoslayer monster's effect, such as Ignister Prominence's destroy or Majesty Pegasus's search.

answers.name: Nibiru, the Primal Being
answers.why: Tribues the whole board after the combo has Summoned five or more monsters, before Master Peace hits the field.

answers.name: Dark Ruler No More
answers.why: Negates Master Peace's negation and Dinoster Power's protection, letting your board breakers resolve.

answers.name: Harpie's Feather Duster
answers.why: Destroys both Pendulum Scales and any Set backrow, stopping the Pendulum Summon and the follow-up.

answers.name: Anti-Spell Fragrance
answers.why: Forces Pendulum Monsters to be Set as Spell Cards before they can be activated, which delays every Pendulum Summon.

profile.plan: A control deck that keeps Continuous 'Blaze Accelerator' Spells on the field to send Pyro monsters from the hand or Deck to the GY and destroy the opponent's monsters, and can wipe the board with Wild Fire.

weaknesses.label: Continuous Spells on the field
weaknesses.why: Blaze Accelerator, Tri-Blaze Accelerator and Volcanic Blaze Accelerator only destroy monsters while their Continuous Spell stays face-up, so backrow removal like Harpie's Feather Duster or Cosmic Cyclone strips the engine.

weaknesses.label: Sends from the Deck to the GY
weaknesses.why: Volcanic Blaze Accelerator's activation sends a 'Blaze Accelerator' from the Deck to the GY, and its once-per-turn effect sends a Level 1 Pyro from the Deck to the GY; Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring negates both.

weaknesses.label: Activated Spell effects
weaknesses.why: The destruction effects of Blaze Accelerator and Volcanic Blaze Accelerator activate on the field, so Ghost Ogre & Snow Rabbit can destroy the Continuous Spell in response and stop the effect.

weaknesses.label: Pyro monsters must reach the GY
weaknesses.why: Every destruction effect needs a Pyro monster sent to the GY, so Macro Cosmos or Dimension Shifter, which banish those cards instead, leave the 'and if you do' clause without a target.

answers.name: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring
answers.why: Negates Volcanic Blaze Accelerator's Deck-to-GY sends and Reload's GY effect.

answers.name: Ghost Ogre & Snow Rabbit
answers.why: Destroys a Continuous 'Blaze Accelerator' Spell when its destruction effect activates.

answers.name: Harpie's Feather Duster
answers.why: Destroys all of the deck's Continuous Spells in one go.

answers.name: Cosmic Cyclone
answers.why: Banishes a key Continuous Spell, stopping its destruction effects.

answers.name: Twin Twisters
answers.why: Discards a card to destroy up to two of the Continuous Spells.

answers.name: Macro Cosmos
answers.why: Makes all cards banished instead of sent to the GY, so the Pyro-fueled destruction never happens.

answers.name: Dimension Shifter
answers.why: For a turn, every card sent to the GY is banished, turning off all the destruction effects.

answers.name: Evenly Matched
answers.why: Banishes the opponent's field, including their Continuous Spells and Token.
